jobs.title: Procurement Excellence Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129217 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT The Richemont Procurement department is responsible for sourcing and purchasing the goods and services that enable our group's operations. We're committed to driving efficiency, sustainability, and innovation in every purchase we make. Our key initiatives include: Strengthening indirect procurement across the group through our P2P Project, ensuring seamless and efficient processes. Embracing data-driven decision-making to optimize every purchase and unlock new opportunities. Digitalizing end-to-end procurement with our eSHOP platform. You will have the opportunity to make a real difference by contributing to the future of procurement, gain valuable experience in data and process management, and discover the world of luxury by working within a leading luxury group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? This is a unique opportunity to explore the worlds of data and process within our dynamic Procurement Excellence team. As Procurement Excellence Intern, you will: Work closely with Procurement and Technology experts to build the future of digital Procurement at Richemont, contributing to a valuable experience. Contribute to the implementation of digital applications. You will participate in tool selection, design, testing, training and communication. Promote the use of our dashboards and data visualization tools, helping to communicate insights and drive informed decision-making. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You're currently pursuing a Master's degree in Commerce or Engineering. You're analytical and enjoy finding innovative solutions to technical and business challenges. You are a technology enthusiast and are curious about the world of data and digital tools. You can collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating strong communication skills throughout. You thrive in dynamic environments, adapting your skills across diverse business and technical landscapes. You're proficient in English. Proficiency in French is appreciated. You’re ready to join our team starting September 2026. You have an internship agreement with your school/university WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory interview. 2. The next step from there would be a second interview with the Procurement Data Project Manager. 3. As a final step, you will have a last interview with the Procurement Senior Process Manager. At the end, hopefully, we can deliver some good news and greet you as our new colleague! #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Piaget Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont Technology Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Prototypiste
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129325 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTEXTE Au sein de l’atelier de Prototypes, vous réalisez les prototypes et les éléments de test des composants habillage et procédez aux ajustements nécessaires, en amont de la fabrication. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Vous collaborez étroitement avec le bureau d'études pour évaluer les plans et la faisabilité des dossiers techniques Vous définissez l’outillage nécessaire et préparez les postes Vous gérez la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commande numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles Vous prenez en charge le contrôle dimensionnel des pièces Vous collaborez avec d’autres départements internes et vous contribuez à l’amélioration continue du département QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Au bénéfice d’un CFC de micro-mécanicien avec une orientation faiseur d’étampes, ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie dans la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commandes numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles. Des compétences en décolletage sont un atout. Vous maîtrisez le logiciel CREO et êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. Vous avez également des connaissances dans la lecture de plans et dans la manipulation des instruments de mesure et de contrôle (calibre, micromètre, comparateur, projecteur, etc.). Des connaissances en bijouterie-joaillerie sont un plus, ainsi que la maîtrise du soudage au chalumeau et laser. Vous êtes une personne motivée, dynamique, polyvalente, ayant un bon esprit d’équipe et appréciez travailler dans un environnement de travail agile. QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? Nous créons un environnement positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et renforcées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour atteindre l'excellence. VOTRE PARCOURS CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique au plus vite avec notre équipe RH. Par la suite, vous accèderez à un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable Prototypes ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Tout au long de son histoire, la Maison Cartier s'est distinguée par l'engagement de chacun de ses employés. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont pleinement assumées, l'innovation et la créativité émergent pour offrir l'excellence. Quelles que soient les différences visibles ou invisibles, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où chacun a une chance égale de réaliser son plein potentiel, d'être entendu et de se sentir valorisé. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129457 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Store Design & Planning: Convert retail design concept into refined architectural layouts ensuring adherence to technical requirements across all sales channels, Master spatial planning principles, zoning definition, and architectural standards to ensure consistent and adaptable execution across diverse regions. Proven ability in creating and validating construction details, workflow management, budget and timeline coordination with local Store Planning teams, Responsible for tracking and maintaining up-to-date design and budget documentation throughout the entire project duration, Demonstrated communications skills for effective collaboration with external stakeholders, business partners, contractors, and operational teams Strategic thinking: Capable in connecting design decisions directly to brand identity, business objectives, and operational impact, Demonstrated proactive problem-solving attitude, breaking down complex challenges into clear frameworks and defining concrete actions End to End accountability: demonstrated experience in taking complete responsibility for ensuring architectural quality from the initial concept phase through to final implementation, Able to offer operational support to ensure excellence in every execution and opening, Able to identify and develop cross-functional projects for department improvement and optimization. Design Mastery Lead research into new materials, trends, and innovative ideas, supporting the team in refining and perfecting brand design codes, Proven ability to translate innovative design concepts into practical, buildable architectural solutions, Proven experience in developing design and technical guidelines. WHAT ABOUT YOU? Degree in Architecture or Interior Design At least 5 years of experience in Retail Design, high-end Retail Architecture, Spatial design across multiple formats and regions highly appreciated Strong design and creative skills, UpToDate with latest trends with an eye on innovation in the sector Passionate about design, art, broader cultural aspects Expert in lighting and illumination design. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129524 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Contrat à durée maximale (CDM) de 2 ans / Horaire nuit ou 2x8 « Notre vision pour le secteur Précieux? Allier la rigueur horlogère à une énergie d'équipe positive. Nous cherchons un mécanicien régleur pour qui l'excellence est un standard, et l'esprit d'équipe une priorité.» CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT Mission Au sein de notre département précieux, vous êtes membre d’une équipe d’environ 10-12 collaborateurs, vous travaillez en horaire d’équipe 2x8 ou de nuit dans un parc de machines CNC (principalement fraisage) et procédez aux réglages ainsi qu’à la production. Responsabilités Assurer la conduite, le réglage, la mise en train de nos machines de fraisage CNC de type Chiron FX/FZ, Micro 5 (UGV), Bumotec S181, CT501 (meulage) lors de l’usinage de nos pièces d’habillage horloger précieux Être garant de la conformité de la fabrication en procédant aux contrôles visuels et dimensionnels et si besoin, effectuer les corrections nécessaires dans le respect des consignes de l'atelier Préparer le poste d’usinage en montant les outils et les posages et en contrôlant la conformité des outillages. Si besoin, effectuer les corrections d’outils nécessaires. S'assurer de la passation des consignes aux équipes relais Participer au nettoyage et à l'entretien des équipements, des machines et des outils ainsi que respecter les règles en matière de Santé et Sécurité au Travail SST Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus et de son environnement de travail ainsi qu'aux actions de formation dans le cadre des évolutions du processus de fabrication CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS CFC de polymécanicien, CFC de mécanicien de production ou BEP/BTS dans le domaine de la mécanique de précision Expérience professionnelle confirmée dans l'usinage CNC Connaissances des machines CNC 5-7 axes avec commande Fanuc serait un plus Bonne maitrise des outils de contrôle dimensionnel habituels, Marcel Aubert et contrôle 3D type Zeiss Personne rigoureuse, motivée, organisée et consciencieuse sachant travailler en équipe. Analytique, vous savez détecter les problèmes et les suivre jusqu’à leur résolution dans une dynamique d’amélioration constante. VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Notre équipe RH se tient à votre écoute, selon votre souhait et vos besoins, tout au long de votre expérience au sein de notre Maison. Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez le Responsable du poste ainsi que notre HR Business Partner. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier. jobs.description: Reference code: JR129654 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT: The Group Product & Trade Compliance department (GPTC) aims to prevent the Group and its Maisons from supply chain disruption and brand reputation damage stemming from regulatory non-compliance. Within the GPTC department, GPTC Data & Operations Excellence team is responsible to manage and orchestrate the best strategy & solutions to ensure Product & Trade Compliance effectiveness within the Group. The mission consists in leveraging best-in-class processes, organization, technology & Data Management implementation and supporting efficient end-to-end operational solutions across Functions, Maisons, and Regions for Compliance effectiveness while decreasing the most possible constraints on impacted processes and organization. In this context, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert leverages a thorough knowledge of our Corporate Trade Compliance Processes & Data to support and accompany our colleagues and partners. He ensures the appropriate Trade Compliance processes, their formalization and optimization on the diversity of global trade activities such import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc. He ensures day-to-day the corresponding knowledge transfer through training or consulting to our internal stakeholders’ community to supports their operations across end-to-end value chain. Co-warrant of our Group compliance effectiveness & control tower, the role is as well instrumental in relevant KPI monitoring, data quality stewardship and suboptimal process identification. When necessary, this will lead to conduct root-cause analyses and the corresponding continuous improvement initiatives for ensuring the robustness and performance of our processes on the long run. Ultimately, thanks to its expertise, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert is eventually acting as a Subject Matter Expert or Stream Lead into broader projects led under other’s entity leadership. YOUR MISSION: Ensure process formalization and process optimization on global trade compliance scope (import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc.). This mission includes the corresponding data management guidelines. Ensure support and consulting service for our internal stakeholders’ community on Trade compliance data and processes. Conduct training in processes and system-driven solutions in place to empower people. Analyse support demand for Trade Compliance implementation solution concerning system and data under our process ownership and conduct the appropriate enhancement or initiative framing to deliver effective & efficient solution. Monitor & Analyse Trade Compliance KPI and act as a Trade Compliance Data Quality Control Tower. Perform data stewardship for data contributed by our stakeholders (Maisons, Group, Region) that are under our responsibility and covered by our Data Governance. Conduct root cause analyze and continuous process improvements initiative Support in projects that require our PTC data management & process expertise. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT: At least 3 years’ experience in an international environment in the field of Trade Compliance Comfortable with Supply Chain & Trade regulatory domain area (HS Commodity Codes, Regulatory documentation & policies interpretation, International Logistics Operational flows,..) jobs.title: Head of Retail Excellence
jobs.description: Reference code: JR129783 Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments. We are on a mission to elevate our retail performance and cultivate an unyielding culture of excellence across our network. To lead this crucial endeavor, we are seeking a visionary Head of Retail Excellence to join our HQ commercial team. Your mission You will be the driving force behind our retail strategies, translating vision into impactful execution on the ground. Your leadership will ensure unparalleled operational excellence, empower our teams through expertly coordinated training, and cultivate extraordinary client experiences by championing best-in-class VIC management. How will you make an impact? Strategy & Vision: Develop and articulate a comprehensive Retail Excellence strategy aligned with the overall commercial objectives and brand vision. Identify key areas for improvement in retail operations, customer experience, and VIC management. Process Optimization & Standardization: Establish and maintain the Retail Excellence framework and associated procedures, ensuring standards, best practices and consistent execution across all network. Customer Experience Enhancement and focus on our top clients: Champion a customer-centric approach, focusing on elevating the end-to-end customer journey. Implement tools and methodologies to measure and improve customer satisfaction (e.g., NPS, mystery shopping programs). Lead VIC programs, ensuring top-tier client engagement and retention at global level. Collaborate with marketing and product teams to ensure a seamless brand experience. Training & Development: Deliver training programs for retail staff on operational procedures, product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer service excellence. Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the retail teams. Work with HR teams and our training content creator as well as talent teams to ensure talent development and succession planning for key retail roles. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Revenue Growth and commercial performance, CRM & Clienteling, SDP & VM teams as well as HR, IT and supply chain departments to ensure integrated and effective retail strategies. Act as a liaison between corporate functions and retail operations to facilitate communication and alignment. Retail Strategic Initiatives: Lead and manage projects related to retail innovation, new store openings, store renovations, and technology implementations in line with the Richemont Roadmap. Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and expected outcomes. How will you experience success? Bachelor’s or master’s Degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in Retail in the luxury or jewelry/watch industry. Proven experience in developing and implementing retail strategies and best operational practices across multiple locations. Strong understanding of luxury customer expectations and service standards. Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies. Excellent PM skills with a track record of successful execution. Strong ability to lead, motivate, and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are needed with an emphasis on detail and organization, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges. Flexibility to travel. Great hands-on mentality and implementation skills. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages relevant to Richemont's global presence (e.g., French, Italian,…) is a significant advantage. What makes Panerai unique? Join a dynamic Maison spirit that values and empowers your unique skills and contributions. Thrive within enriching communities built on genuine care, continuous improvement, and efficient accountability. Collaborate across borders and cultures, gaining invaluable international experience. Embark on a fulfilling career journey within Panerai and across the Richemont Group. Your journey with us Our recruitment journey is designed to offer insight and enriching exchanges, grounded in transparency, respect and fairness. The recruitment process includes conversations with the Hiring Manager, key business partners, and members of our executive teams. Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129923 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. QUELLE SERA VOTRE CONTRIBUTION ? En tant que membre de notre équipe R&I Electronic Systems & Solutions (E2S), vous serez le chef d'orchestre de projets complexes et impactants : Pilotage de projets d'innovation : Mener le cadrage, la planification et le suivi de projets R&I stratégiques, depuis la phase d'étude exploratoire jusqu'au transfert de technologie. Définir et gérer les objectifs, les livrables, les plannings et les risques, en vous appuyant sur des méthodologies Agile et Prince2. Coordonner et animer les équipes techniques, les partenaires internes (Manufactures, Maisons) et externes, garantissant une collaboration fluide et efficace. Assurer la rédaction et la formalisation de la documentation projet à chaque étape clé. Expertise technique Firmware & Ultra Low Power : Concevoir et déployer des architectures logicielles embarquées robustes et évolutives, capables de supporter le développement de nos produits. Développer des preuves de concept (POC) et prototypes, avec une approche système intégrée (hardware, software, mécanique). Implémenter et valider des firmwares performants en C, C++ et Python, avec une expertise reconnue sur les microcontrôleurs STM32 et une connaissance des EFR32. Maîtriser l'optimisation de puissance à un niveau micro-ampère et nano-ampère, en gérant finement les modes de veille, l'utilisation du MCU et les périphériques pour atteindre des consommations ultra-faibles. Intégrer et piloter des capteurs complexes via des interfaces comme SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC et des techniques de bitbang. Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de développement rigoureuses, incluant l'utilisation de GIT pour le contrôle de versions, le débogage embarqué et le JTAG. Veille technologique & Innovation : Être force de proposition sur les technologies, concepts et axes de développement innovants qui soutiennent la stratégie R&I du Groupe. Assurer une veille technologique active sur les dernières avancées en systèmes embarqués, microélectronique et gestion de l'énergie. Support à l'industrialisation : Apporter un support technique expert aux Manufactures et Maisons lors du passage en production et garantir la qualité et la robustesse des solutions déployées. QUELLES SONT LES CLÉS DE VOTRE RÉUSSITE ? Ingénieur.e en électronique, systèmes embarqués, microtechnique ou équivalent. Vous justifiez d'une première expérience significative (3 à 5 ans) en développement firmware et en gestion de projets techniques complexes, avec une expertise reconnue en ultra-basse consommation. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise approfondie des langages C et Python. Expertise en architecture logicielle embarquée et capacité à concevoir des solutions évolutives. Connaissance avérée des microcontrôleurs STM32 et une familiarité avec les EFR32. Compétence primordiale en optimisation énergétique pour des applications ultra-low power (cibles nA/µA). Connaissance des interfaces de communication (SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC, bitbang). Pratique de l'intégration de capteurs. Maîtrise des outils de gestion de version comme GIT. Expérience en débogage embarqué et utilisation de JTAG. Expérience en gestion de projet ; connaissance des méthodologies Agile (Scrum, Kanban) et Prince2, un plus. Doté.e d'une forte autonomie, d'un sens aigu de l'organisation et d'excellentes capacités de communication, vous savez fédérer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et résoudre des problèmes complexes avec rigueur et esprit d'analyse. Vous êtes proactif.ve dans l'exploration et l'adoption d'outils innovants, y compris ceux basés sur l'Intelligence Artificielle, pour améliorer l'efficacité du développement. Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit. Le poste est basé principalement à Buttes, au cœur de notre laboratoire d’innovation, avec une présence régulière dans notre hub R&I de Neuchâtel pour favoriser les échanges d’équipe et les synergies. 
• Nous offrons un cadre de travail souple et équilibré grâce à des horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité d’une journée de télétravail par semaine. Il s'agit d'un poste d’une durée de 12 mois, avec possibilité de renouvellement. VOTRE EXPÉRIENCE CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous inviterons pour une entrevue dans nos locaux avec le Responsable du Pôle et le HR Business Partner. Dans un deuxième temps, nous vous soumettrons un cas pratique à réaliser et venir présenter devant un parterre d’experts. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Ingénieur R&I Mécatronique/Electronique Save Buttes, Switzerland Richemont Coordinateur.rice Données (H/F) Save Paris, France Cartier Constructeur Mouvement (H/F) Save Villeret, Switzerland Montblanc

jobs.title: Data Scientist Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129875 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. We would like to talk to you about the opportunity to join our Maison for an internship as Data Scientist Intern (6 months). As Data Scientist Intern, contribute to the ARIA machine learning project by revamping and enhancing an existing model for short and long-term daily sales prediction. The objective is to update the current outdated model, adapt it to existing data sources, and extend its capabilities to include very short-term (maximum 3 days) predictions for traffic and transactions. Ultimately, this project aims to create an intelligent assistant to help organize boutique operations and provide worldwide forecasts to inform strategic decision-making. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?
• Revamping the existing machine learning model within the ARIA project
• Adapting the chosen model to integrate with current and existing data sources
• Extending the model's predictive scope to include traffic and transaction forecasts REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & PROFILE:
• Engineering School or Master Degree with a specialization in applied mathematics or computer science
• Analytical mindset and structuring skills
• Fluency in English is required; French is a plus WHAT DO WE OFFER
• We create a positive environment and highlight your personal and team performances.
• We’re fully transparent and share with you: Maison strategies, key information, needs of others Corporate Departments.
• We constantly educate you with: Cartier’s savoir-faire, competitive landscape, industry news, client experience best practices. jobs.title: New Foundations Scope & Simplification Manager

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Scoping e Semplificazione – New Foundations
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Portée et Simplification – New Foundations

jobs.description: Reference code: JR130030 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation. As Scope and Simplification Manager for New Foundations, you will drive business process transformation and configuration simplification across the programme, ensuring scope decisions are grounded in business impact, value and transformation readiness. Working in close partnership with the organisation and reporting to Programme Director, you will leverage your SAP S/4HANA expertise to bridge the gap between Richemont’s current operations and its future-state processes, functionalities and configuration — acting as the guardian of simplicity, harmonisation and clean-core discipline. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will: Own the assessment of current business processes and configuration against SAP S/4HANA standards, identifying transformation opportunities, business impacts and change efforts. Orchestrate the work of Business Process Managers (BPMs) and functional teams to map, challenge and optimise end-to-end processes, ensuring process ownership stays with the business. Lead simplification initiatives across processes and custom code, looking to standardise, harmonise or carry forward based on business value and operational impact. Frame keep / adapt / retire decisions through a business-value lens to right-size the ERP. Assess the business impact of scope decisions, ensuring the organisation understands the changes, operational consequences and transformation readiness. Work to upskill the organization on SAP S/4HANA processes and standard functionalities, building functional fluency across business teams. Work closely with the ECC Functional Expert to anchor recommendations in the reality of the current landscape, surfacing constraints, risks and dependencies. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Experience with SAP S/4HANA programmes and transformations. Proven track record in process simplification or standardisation in complex environments. Strong exposure to end-to-end business processes (for example Finance, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash). Comfortable engaging with senior business and Senior Technology leaders. Experience operating in Group, multi-entity or multi-brand environments. Skilled at translating business requirements into standard, scalable SAP S/4HANA outcomes. Deep understanding of SAP S/4HANA standard processes, clean-core principles and, where possible, the ECC landscape. Solid process modelling and documentation capability and experience. Analytical rigour to frame keep / adapt / retire decisions with clear trade-offs. Ability to distil complexity into actionable scope and simplification options. Effective stakeholder communication across senior business and technology audiences. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Our recruitment journey for this role is designed to be respectful, transparent and grounded in genuine dialogue. You can typically expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations and the role. A meeting with Hiring Manager and HR for this role. Subsequent interviews with key Group Platforms stakeholders and members of the New Foundations programme team to explore your experience in depth. A final conversation focused on mutual fit, expectations and next steps. We are committed to providing timely, transparent feedback at each stage of the process. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Programme Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont SAP Platform Architect Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation. As Technical Manager for New Foundations, you will own the target technology architecture and shape the technology evolution path required to deliver Richemont’s SAP S/4HANA migration. You will ensure that the adoption decisions made through scope and simplification translate into a coherent, future-proof and sustainable enterprise landscape, extending well beyond the conversion event itself. Working under the Programme Director, you will collaborate with technology experts to define the migration roadmap with Group Platforms and guide the evolution of the ERP landscape across the programme lifecycle. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will: Own the target-state technology architecture and define the future SAP S/4HANA-centred landscape — ERP core, satellites, integrations and extensions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and third-party platforms. Translate scope and simplification decisions into a viable and scalable architecture blueprint, aligned with Group architecture principles and clean-core strategy. Define clear ERP boundaries, ensuring consistency between what is removed or simplified and what is rebuilt, extended or externalised. Own the integration and extensibility strategy, including application programming interfaces (APIs), middleware and event-driven patterns. Assess technical feasibility, dependencies and sequencing, anchoring ambition in technical reality. Prepare technology principles, architecture guardrails and the inputs required for Solution Design. Partner with product and technical teams to upskill on SAP S/4HANA and ensure decisions are grounded in technical reality. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Senior experience in large-scale ERP and platform transformations (SAP S/4HANA is a must). Proven track record in Technical Architecture in complex environments. Deep experience designing hybrid landscapes (ERP, satellites, data, integrations, cloud platforms). Comfortable engaging with senior technology and business leaders, including ExCo-level forums. Experience operating in an international multi-entity or multi-brand environments. Strong mastery of SAP S/4HANA architecture patterns, clean-core principles and extensibility models. Deep understanding of integration architectures, APIs, middleware and SAP BTP. Ability to translate simplification and legacy constraints into forward-looking architecture choices. Strong analytical capability to frame technology trade-offs (standard vs flexibility vs cost). Structured decision framing, with a focus on long-term operability and scalability. Strong long-term and systems thinking. Comfortable holding the line on architectural non-negotiables. Credible authority with both technology and business stakeholders. Acts as a steward of future value, not a defender of current solutions. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. jobs.title: Constructeur Mouvement (H/F)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130111 Since MONTBLANC revolutionized writing culture in 1906 with the first spill-proof fountain pen, we have been known for outstanding craftsmanship, highest aesthetics, and innovative solutions. And we keep pushing the boundaries. We combine the best of tradition, technology and design in writing instruments, watches, leather goods, new technologies and selected accessories. With our name and in our emblem, we embody this mission: to implement bold ideas with outstanding craftsmanship and create refined products for people with highest expectations. In doing so, we are at the forefront of technology and design, drawing on the passion of more than 3,000 employees and living a culture that - like our products - inspires people to unleash their potential, to thrive and to achieve. Responsabilités Principales : 1. Conception et Développement :
• Concevoir et développer des mouvements horlogers mécaniques en utilisant des logiciels de CAO 2D et 3D PTC Creo et Tellwatch
• Réaliser les études de faisabilité technique et les analyses fonctionnelles des nouveaux mouvements ou des évolutions de mouvements existants.
• Définir les architectures mécaniques, les cinématiques et les tolérances dimensionnelles des composants.
• Intégrer les contraintes esthétiques, techniques, de coût et de production dès la phase de conception 2. Collaboration avec l’industrialisation et Prototypage :
• Établir les dossiers techniques complets (plans de fabrication, nomenclatures, spécifications techniques) pour le prototypage et la production.
• Collaborer avec l'atelier de prototypage et le chef de projet pour la réalisation des premières pièces et l'assemblage des mouvements.
• Participer aux phases de tests et de validation des prototypes, analyser les résultats et proposer des améliorations.
• Assurer le suivi technique lors de la phase d'industrialisation et de mise en production en série. 3. Optimisation et Amélioration Continue :
• Rechercher et proposer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la performance, la fiabilité, la précision et la facilité d'assemblage des mouvements.
• Optimiser les coûts de fabrication sans compromettre la qualité. 4. Collaboration et Communication :
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les designers, les horlogers, les méthodes, les chefs de projets et les équipes de production.
• Présenter les avancées techniques et les solutions aux équipes internes et à la direction.
• Participer aux revues de projet et aux réunions techniques. Qualifications Requises :
• Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur en microtechnique orientation horlogerie ou titre jugé équivalent
• Expérience : Minimum 5 années d'expérience significative dans la conception et le développement de mouvements horlogers complexes, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture de haute horlogerie. Compétences Techniques :
• Maîtrise approfondie des principes de la mécanique horlogère et des complications.
• Expertise des logiciels PTC Creo et Windchill
• Connaissance des matériaux horlogers et des procédés de fabrication (usinage, découpe, traitement de surface, etc.).
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans techniques complexes.
• Connaissance des normes et standards de l'industrie horlogère.
• Langues : Maîtrise du français Qualités Personnelles :
• Rigueur, précision et souci du détail.
• Créativité et esprit d'innovation.
• Capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Excellent esprit d'équipe et aptitudes à la communication.
• Passion pour l'horlogerie et la mécanique de précision. Similar Jobs CDD - Sales Advisor (H/F) Save Marne La Vallee, France Montblanc Stage long Assistant de Vente - Montblanc (H/F) Save Lyon, France Montblanc Stage - PR & Communication (H/F) Save Paris, France Montblanc

jobs.title: New Foundations Programme Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130029 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation. As Programme Manager for New Foundations, you will own the day-to-day orchestration, cadence and operational discipline of this strategic transformation programme. You will ensure the programme runs as a single, integrated effort, with decisions, risks and dependencies tracked and executed consistently across all workstreams. Partnering closely with the Programme Director, the programme team and wider Group Platforms stakeholders, you will be the trusted operational backbone of the programme, with no content ownership. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will: Co-design the New Foundations programme with the Programme Director and wider Group Platforms stakeholders, translating ambition, governance and decisions into a structured and executable plan. Orchestrate overall programme execution, ensuring all streams progress in line with agreed scope, cadence and priorities. Maintain a single integrated view of the programme and own its cadence and rhythm — planning cycles, forums, milestones and decision tracking. Prepare and drive arbitration processes with relevant stakeholders, framing options, impacts and trade-offs for the Programme Director and Group Platforms Executive Committee (ExCo). Track decisions and non-negotiables, ensuring commitments are clearly recorded and reflected in plans and deliverables, following up on actions, managing slippage and escalating risks early. Coordinate documentation and readiness for Discovery deliverables and the planning and preparation of Solution Design. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Strong background in programme orchestration and complex delivery environments. Experience operating in multi-entity, Group-level programmes Exposure to large-scale ERP transformations, ideally including SAP S/4HANA conversions. Experience working with external consulting partners during initial programme set-up. Programme structuring and planning, including cadence, milestones and dependency management. Rigorous tracking and follow-through, turning decisions into executable actions. Risk and issue management, with early identification and escalation. Clear synthesis and framing, consolidating complex inputs into concise programme views. Strong coordination across business, technology, finance and change management teams. Highly disciplined, structured and execution-oriented. Comfortable operating in complex environment Focused on outcomes, follow-through and operational excellence. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Our recruitment journey for this role is designed to be respectful, transparent and grounded in genuine dialogue. You can typically expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations and the role. A meeting with Hiring Manager and HR for this role. A final conversation focused on mutual fit, expectations and next steps. We are committed to providing timely, transparent feedback at each stage of the process. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Scope & Simplification Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont SAP Platform Architect Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Anaplan Model Builder
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130201 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. As one of the core building block of the Cartier Data Office, Connected Planning is a critical, yet rapidly expending part of our Data ecosystem. The Anaplan model builder has a key role in the development of the solution within the Maison and the maintenance of the models ensuring operational efficiency and business continuity. As a model builder, you will ensure that models used Maison-wide are matching industry standard best practices and delivering the best level of performance and robustness. How will you make an impact? You will have the following responsibilities: Model building Implement best practices for model development, including version control, documentation and technical optimizations. Proactively keep a high level of technical expertise, and stay up to date with latest developments of the Solution. Ensure robustness and perennity of the models. Ensure data integrity, accuracy and reliability within the models. Maintain comprehensive documentation including design specifications, formulas, and assumptions. Maintenance Investigate and resolve issues related to Anaplan models, including data inconsistencies, formula errors, and system performance. Provide support to end-users. New projects Collaborate with business stakeholders from different department of the Maison. Work with project teams to understand their challenges and requirements. Translate them into scalable and efficient Anaplan models. Supporting new projects from the beginning to a successful launch. Collaborate and federate Facilitate the exchanges of experience and best practices among domains, while evaluating the appropriate help based on their specific needs. Actively contribute to the Anaplan community by sharing knowledge, collaborating on projects and driving innovation. 
• Your profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Management, or a related field. Proven experience as an Anaplan Model builder and Anaplan Model builder certification are a must. Anaplan Solution Architect certification is a plus. Experience in Supply Chain Experience working with Agile methodologies and management tools (e.g. Jira). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Understanding of supply chain processes is a plus. English and French. How do we keep you smiling? You will play an active role into our Transformation journey, working on solutions that individually generate immediate value, but that collectively enrich our data platform, opening the door to further value creation. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130276 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will work within Group Supply Chain Execution team to enrich the new Supply Chain Knowledge platform for Watch and Jewelry Maisons, interacting directly with them to build the right approach for publishing and enhancing Group Operating Model knowledge and ensuring W&J business continuity through it. You will be involved in various ongoing projects to be able to capitalize on documentation and allow the W&J knowledge to spread through the various Group Supply Chain actors in a more structured way and better user accessibility. You will also deliver the documentation within the appropriate tools, validate each key processes with Maisons and experts, and support the final publication on the platform, looking for a “User buy-in” of this reshuffled and completed documentation platform WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE? You will bring: your desire to explore the Supply Chain end-to-end business models, procedures, and best practices of our Watch & Jewelry Maisons your appetence for detailed process mapping and for tools associated. your soft skills to interact with the Supply Chain departments of our W&J Maisons, IT department, and Richemont Group technical experts. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains. You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two hundred years of heritage with cutting edge innovation. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Fribourg, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130546 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Business Analyst Intern Starting Date: September Duration: 6 months (100%, full-time) Location: Bellevue, GE, CH YOU WANT TO: Discover a unique distribution brand Improve your business & commercial know-how in a fast-paced & agile environment Support a wide range of topics (distribution, performance, operations…) with a varied list stakeholders, including other functions, Maisons & retailers Then you must be the right talent to join TimeVallée! Launched in 2014, TimeVallée is a visionary multi-brand watch retail concept offering a curated selection of the most prestigious watchmaking Maisons with a complete range of experiences and services. Fully operated by strategic partners, TimeVallée’s mission is to provide a complete turnkey solution: a 360 brand concept to support the Maison and retail partners , a customer-centric approach to maximize engagement and retention, cross-industry partnerships & unique experiences to boost client acquisition while always looking at excellence in execution. With more than 50 stores worldwide, TimeVallée is the only multi-brand with a global presence and its ambition is to drive a qualitative and sustainable network growth. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Reporting to the Business Performance & Development Manager, you will be assisting the team as follows: Support the timely delivery & accuracy of recurring/ad-hoc presentations and analyses responding to TimeVallée business priorities Prepare templates, research, export and consolidate data for analysis for deployment to maisons, retailers, other group functions and top management Ensure the updates, maintenance and improvements of various TimeVallée commercial files Document existing business processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness This is a unique opportunity to learn from both the strategic perspective of our headquarters team and the practical realities of working directly with our retail partners, Maisons and other group functions, providing a well-rounded learning experience. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Enrolled in a Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field First experience as a business analyst or similar role Fluency in English Excellent proficiency in Excel & PowerPoint Prior experience working with data visualization tools, looker is a plus Proactivity, entrepreneurship & team spirit with ability to work independently Business oriented with analytical skills Available for a 6-month internship starting in September 2026 You have a mandatory internship agreement by your university WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. The next step from there would be an interview with the Hiring Manager. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.description: Reference code: JR130767 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Store Planning and Construction Project Manager, you will spearhead the full lifecycle of Piaget's retail development projects across the Europe Region, from design to post-opening. This pivotal role, blending Headquarters and regional responsibilities, ensures both Brand desirability through design excellence and Brand productivity via operational efficiency, quality, cost control, and sustainability. You will be instrumental in delivering the region's retail development and renovation program, upholding brand desirability, execution quality, project planning, budget, and sustainability commitments. Regular travel across France, Switzerland, Italy, and Nordics is essential for site assessments and project oversight. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design: Coordinate design development from concept to construction documentation, ensuring consistency with Piaget's architectural standards and Brand identity. Manage external design specialists (architects, 3D artists, consultants). Collaborate with HQ Retail, VM, and Commercial teams to optimize retail experience and operational efficiency. Budgeting, Planning & Construction: Lead projects from investment validation through construction and close-out, developing and controlling budgets, CAPEX, and planning. Drive tendering, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract awards. Manage procurement, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, and financial reporting. Coordinate permitting, landlord approvals, and local authority relations. Act as a key stakeholder with Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, and external partners throughout the project. Manage all construction phases, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to Piaget's quality and sustainability standards. Risk Management: Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans. Maintenance: Coordinate regional maintenance and post-opening programs, including snagging, retrofit projects, and minor works. Maintain regular communication with Commercial teams and Boutique Directors across Europe. Ensure compliance with Piaget Brand standards, quality, and sustainability objectives. Transversal Management: Act as the primary HQ interface for the Europe Region, coordinating Regional Markets for boutique construction and maintenance. Collaborate closely with internal teams (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Security, VM, Content) and develop strong relationships with external partners (landlords, consultants, contractors). HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Experience: Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Construction Project Management, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Planning and Construction. Proven track record delivering international retail projects within the luxury industry or premium brands. Solid understanding of luxury design, construction processes, and operational excellence. Extensive experience managing Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, General Contractors, and specialist consultants. Strong knowledge of procurement, tender management, commercial negotiations, and cost control. Technical Competencies: Exceptional analytical, planning, and project management skills. Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities. Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite knowledge. Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a significant asset. Strong commercial awareness, proven negotiation skills, and construction cost expertise. Soft Skills: Creative, solution-oriented, and passionate about luxury retail environments, architecture, and design trends. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, effective in multicultural teams. Agile, adaptable, and adept at managing changing priorities and complex stakeholder landscapes. Strong decision-maker with a high sense of ownership, accountability, and a results-oriented, continuous improvement mindset. Highly organized, proactive, and capable of simultaneously managing multiple strategic projects. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! jobs.description: Reference code: JR130768 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Store Design and Planning Project Manager, you will be the architectural heart of Piaget's global retail network. This pivotal role combines your architectural creativity with strategic project leadership, driving design excellence, innovation, and consistent implementation of Piaget’s retail concept worldwide. You will guide regional project managers, ensuring every flagship, boutique, and shop-in-shop embodies our brand's architectural standards and delivers an unparalleled client experience. Prepare for regular international travel to shape our most prestigious projects. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design Development: Lead end-to-end design for Piaget Flagships, Boutiques, and Shop-in-Shops, from concept to approval. Ensure designs embody Piaget’s luxury identity, brand DNA, and deliver innovative client experiences. Manage external design specialists (architects, lighting, 3D artists). Oversee review of layouts, materials, mock-ups, and documentation. Collaborate closely with internal Retail, VM, Marketing, Product, and Client Experience teams. HQ Design Governance & Brand Desirability: Serve as HQ Design Authority for your region, guiding Regional Project Managers. Validate architectural proposals and shop drawings, ensuring adherence to Piaget’s WW Store Design Guidelines. Support regional teams in tendering, Value Engineering, and construction to protect design intent. Drive continuous evolution of Piaget’s retail concept, design standards, and technical guidelines. Lead aesthetic maintenance and minor works for boutiques across their lifecycle. Project Leadership: Lead strategic flagship and retail projects from concept through design validation. Coordinate multidisciplinary consultants throughout the design process. Provide design-centric review of project planning, budgets, and Value Engineering. Present designs at key Boutique Design Committee meetings and reviews. Champion innovation, prototyping, and concept validation for future retail. Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Research and integrate cutting-edge architectural trends, luxury retail concepts, materials, and technologies. Promote sustainable design solutions and innovative construction methods. Develop new design details, furniture solutions, and retail standards. Transversal Management: Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with internal Retail, Partner Network, VM, and Content teams. Build strategic relationships with external consultants, contractors, and partners. Share best practices to continuously improve Store Planning processes and technical standards. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Experience: Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Retail Design, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Design and Planning. Proven track record leading flagship retail projects and premium architectural developments within luxury or international premium brands. Deep understanding of retail design development, construction detailing, and luxury client experience. Demonstrated ability to coordinate multidisciplinary international teams and external consultants. Technical Competencies: Exceptional architectural design, space planning, and project management capabilities. Outstanding presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a plus. Soft Skills: Highly creative with a strong sensitivity to luxury architecture and craftsmanship, capable of transforming concepts into exceptional retail experiences. Excellent communication and influencing skills, thriving in multicultural environments. Strong leadership, coordination, and ownership, inspiring and guiding regional teams. Curious, innovative, and proactive, continuously seeking new architectural inspirations and managing multiple strategic projects simultaneously. Collaborative, agile, and committed to continuous improvement. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! jobs.title: Horloger Service Client International H/F (CDD)
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130817 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante. Prenez part à notre succès collectif et à la création de notre héritage futur. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON Le département Service Client, a pour mission d'assurer l'excellence relationnelle et d'améliorer l'expérience client. Pour cela, nous nous appuyons sur une expertise solide, des projets innovants et une performance opérationnelle guidée par les données ; dans les critères d’excellence de la Maison. Nous recherchons un Horloger Service Client International (H/F) pour un contrat à durée déterminée pensé comme un véritable tremplin au sein de notre Maison. Notre objectif est de développer un vivier d’horlogers compétents et performants désirant s'investir à long terme dans une carrière à l’international pour notre Maison, que ce soit en plateforme de réparation ou en boutique, selon les besoins de notre réseau. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER Dans le cadre de ce CDD qui a pour but de développer votre expertise sur nos produits tout en contribuant à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’atelier de réparation service client, vous serez responsable de : Effectuer le diagnostic des pièces ainsi que les préparations et contrôles de sous-traitance Assurer l’entretien et la restauration des montres afin de garantir une restitution des produits en conformité avec les critères de qualité de Vacheron Constantin et des délais impartis Effectuer le démontage et le nettoyage des pièces Remplacer les composants défectueux Assurer l’assemblage, le réglage et/ou l’emboitage des pièces Travailler en autocontrôle et être force de proposition pour l’amélioration de l’environnement de travail et la performance de l’atelier LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur : Votre motivation à travailler sur de belles pièces tout en vous challengeant au quotidien sur l’atteinte des objectifs et en participant à la bonne dynamique d’équipe Votre expérience complète en tant qu’horloger, idéalement démarrée par un apprentissage et complété par plusieurs années d’expérience dans le domaine Votre envie de vivre une expérience à l’internationale associée à un très bon relationnel et votre appétence pour les interactions avec les clients Votre excellente maîtrise du français, avec idéalement un bon niveau d’anglais Votre sens de l’organisation, votre efficacité et votre autonomie Vacheron Constantin a célébré ses 271 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. jobs.title: GL Accountant
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130897 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Au cœur de notre département finance à Fribourg, composé d’environ 80 collaborateurs, vous serez en charge de la tenue de la comptabilité de nos entités suisses, tout en garantissant le respect des normes en vigueur. Vous agirez également en tant qu’interlocuteur privilégié de nos différents partenaires pour assurer une communication optimale et partager votre expertise sur les sujets de la comptabilité. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS FAIRE LA DIFFÉRENCE ? Tâches comptables principales Suivre, réconcilier et lettrer l’ensemble des comptes GL Suivre et réconcilier les comptes interco & intraco Préparer et enregistrer les écritures de clôture Préparer et expliquer le reporting mensuel Effectuer et présenter la revue analytique des comptes mensuels Documenter les contrôles ICS Promouvoir les règles comptables groupe Suivre la comptabilité générale Appliquer et faire appliquer les procédures comptables groupe Garantir la mise en application du système de contrôle interne en vigueur Agir comme contact clé pour nos partenaires (entités, maisons, fonctions) pour les sujets de comptabilité générale COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS CONNAÎTRE LE SUCCÈS AVEC NOUS ? Passionné par la comptabilité et à l'aise avec les chiffres, vous vous distinguez notamment par les compétences ci-dessous : Rigoureux, fiable et précis Excellente organisation et gestion des priorités A l’aise avec la complexité Sens de la discrétion et de la confidentialité Résilience et capacité à naviguer en environnement complexe Flexibilité et adaptabilité Expérience, formation et compétences-métier : Formation initiale d’employé de commerce avec maturité professionnelle ou équivalent complétée d’une certification en comptabilité ou équivalent Min. 3 ans d'expérience à un poste similaire, de préférence en environnement international Bonnes connaissances des normes comptables (IFRS, CO) Excellente maîtrise des différents outils usuels (MS-Office) Une première expérience sur SAP est souhaitable De langue maternelle française, vous avez de bonnes connaissances en anglais (B2). L’allemand est un atout QU’EST-CE QUI DIFFÉRENCIE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à favoriser un potentiel inexploité. Nous valorisons la collégialité, le courage, la curiosité, l'empathie, l’humilité et l’intégrité. Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE EXPÉRIENCE CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Votre candidature sera attentivement analysée par nos équipes de recrutement puis un retour vous parviendra dans les meilleurs délais. Si votre profil est retenu, nous vous contacterons pour un premier échange téléphonique. jobs.title: Senior Anaplan Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130985 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Correspondez-vous au profil ? Vous êtes fort(e) d’une solide expérience sur des enjeux d’architecture/model bulding de solutions de planning. Vous maitrisez parfaitement Anaplan et avez une forte sensibilité fonctionnelle. Vous êtes orienté(e) projet – méthodes agile et cycles en V. Curieux(se) et force de proposition, vous agissez dans une optique d’amélioration et de recherche de la solution optimale. Vous êtes doté(e) d’excellentes aptitudes relationnelles afin d’évoluer avec de nombreuses équipes en transverse. Vous êtes force de proposition et de persuasion afin de conseiller efficacement les équipes. Vous êtes organisé(e) et faites preuve de rigueur. Analytique, vous êtes à l’aise avec les chiffres. Vous êtes agile et autonome. Vous maitrisez l’anglais. Si tel est le cas, n’hésitez pas à postuler ! Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Au sein du département Technology & Data et rattaché(e) au Senior Manager Data Enablement & Planning Systems, vous êtes en charge de la mise en œuvre de projets Anaplan transverses pour la Maison. Vous intervenez depuis l’expression du besoin jusqu’au support post go-live. Vous animez, développez et faites évoluer les applications Anaplan. Dans le cadre de vos fonctions : Vous assurez le bon déroulement des projets Anaplan, depuis les phases de cadrage jusqu’au déploiement des applications ainsi que la gestion et planification budgétaire.
