jobs.title: CLIENT EXPERIENCE PROJECT MANAGER
jobs.description: Reference code: JR131006 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. You will be responsible for developing and deploying innovative in-store and online client experiences that bring Jaeger-LeCoultre's manufacture heritage to life from phygital installations in flagship boutiques to digital storytelling on the brand's online platforms. Strong project ownership, rigorous coordination, and a client-centric mindset are essential to succeed in this role. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? 1. Retail & Phygital Instore Experience Lead the end-to-end development and implementation of in-store client experiences integrating brand storytelling through: Interactive and phygital installations of new Client Experience in all new POS openings In-store screen deployment and audiovisual experiences in all POS in coordination with external agency Integration of manufacture storytelling content into retail software platforms Full ownership of related project budgets: purchase orders, invoice tracking, financial forecasting Reporting frameworks to evaluate experience effectiveness, turning qualitative and quantitative insights into improvement Source watchmaking content in close collaboration with the Manufacture Ateliers, Heritage department, and Product Marketing team. Coordinate planning, installation and animation of new tools with dedicated teams. 2. Boutique Rollout & Activation Manage the end-to-end implementation of client experience initiatives for new boutique openings and existing locations: Ensure consistent execution and adherence to brand guidelines across all markets Collaborate with Store Design Planning , VM, and commercial teams to align on timelines, installation logistics, and brand standards Act as the primary point of contact for markets throughout rollout phases Support adoption of new tools at POS by developing usage guidelines and training toolkits 3. Online Watchmaking Experience In close coordination with the internal digital and CRM teams, you will pilot projects to enhance the brand's online watchmaking experience: Manage the integration of manufacture storytelling content onto the website Oversee with external agency and creative contact, the development of new functionalities on the dedicated online booking platform, acting as project lead WHAT ABOUT YOU? Experience & Background 2 - 3 years of proven experience in project management within luxury retail, client experience, VM or trade marketing Demonstrated track record of deploying phygital tools or experiential retail installations across multiple markets Familiarity with boutique rollout processes and retail operations is a plus Skills & Competencies Cross-functional project management: ability to coordinate multiple internal stakeholders and external vendors Strong business acumen combined with a genuine sensitivity to luxury brand codes Analytical mindset: comfortable building and interpreting reporting frameworks and performance data Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, familiarity with project management and reporting tools is a plus Client-centric mindset with strong business acumen and a genuine sensitivity to luxury brand codes Excellent communication and presentation skills Curious and proactive, with an innovative mindset always looking to improve existing experiences and bring new ideas Detail-oriented and highly organised, able to manage multiple concurrent projects Languages: French & English mandatory (working languages) Similar Jobs STORE DESIGN PLANNING BRAND ARCHITECT - 6/9 MONTHS Save Meyrin, Switzerland Jaeger-LeCoultre Store Design Planning Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Jaeger-LeCoultre Marketing Activations Project Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Jaeger-LeCoultre

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR131006 Dal 1833, guidato da una sete incrollabile di innovazione e creatività, e ispirato dal tranquillo ambiente naturale della sua casa nella Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre si distingue per la sua padronanza delle complicazioni e la precisione dei suoi meccanismi. Conosciuto come Watchmaker of Watchmakers, la Manifattura ha espresso il suo spirito incessantemente inventivo attraverso la creazione di oltre 1.400 diversi calibri e il riconoscimento di oltre 430 brevetti. Sfruttando 190 anni di esperienza accumulata, i produttori orologiai La Grande Maison progettano, producono, rifiniscono e ornano i meccanismi più avanzati e precisi, fondendo la passione con la savoir-faire secolare, collegando il passato al futuro, senza tempo ma sempre al passo con i tempi. Con 180 competenze riunite sotto un unico tetto, la Manifattura crea orologi pregiati che combinano l'ingegno tecnico con la bellezza estetica e una sofisticazione contraddistinta. Sarete responsabili per lo sviluppo e la distribuzione di esperienze innovative in-store e clienti online che portano il patrimonio di produzione di Jaeger-LeCoultre alla vita da installazioni fittizie in boutique di punta a storytelling digitale sulle piattaforme online del marchio. Forte proprietà del progetto, coordinamento rigoroso, e una mentalità orientata al cliente sono essenziali per avere successo in questo ruolo. Come fai a fare un'infezione? 1. Retail & Phygital Instore Experience Condurre lo sviluppo end-to-end e l'implementazione di esperienze client in-store che integrano la narrazione del marchio attraverso: installazioni interattive e fisiche di nuova Customer Experience in tutte le nuove aperture POS In-store implementazione dello schermo ed esperienze audiovisive in tutti i POS in coordinamento con l'agenzia esterna Integrazione del contenuto di storytelling manifatturiera in piattaforme software di vendita al dettaglio La piena proprietà dei relativi budget di progetto: ordini di acquisto, monitoraggio delle fatture, previsione finanziaria Quadri di reporting per valutare l'efficacia dell'esperienza, trasformando gli insight qualitativi e quantitativi in miglioramento. Coordinate la pianificazione, l'installazione e l'animazione di nuovi strumenti con team dedicati. 2. Boutique Rollout & Activation Gestire l'implementazione end-to-end di iniziative di customer experience per nuove aperture di boutique e luoghi esistenti: Assicurare l'esecuzione coerente e l'aderenza alle linee guida del marchio in tutti i mercati Collaborare con Store Design Planning, VM e team commerciali per allineare le linee temporali, la logistica di installazione e gli standard del marchio Act come punto primario di contatto per i mercati durante le fasi di rollout Supporta l'adozione di nuovi strumenti a POS sviluppando linee guida di utilizzo e strumenti di formazione 3. Esperienza di orologi online In stretto coordinamento con i team interni di digital e CRM, piloterai progetti per migliorare l'esperienza di orologiera online del marchio: Gestire l'integrazione dei contenuti di storytelling di fabbricazione sul sito web Superare con agenzia esterna e contatto creativo, lo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità sulla piattaforma di prenotazione online dedicata, agendo come project lead COSA DI SOLO? Esperienza & Sfondo 2 - 3 anni di comprovata esperienza nella gestione del progetto all'interno del retail di lusso, esperienza del cliente, VM o marketing commerciale Il record di traccia dimostrata di implementare strumenti fisici o installazioni di vendita al dettaglio esperienziale in più mercati La familiarità con i processi di rollout boutique e le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio è un plus Skills & Competencies Gestione del progetto eccellente: capacità di coordinare più stakeholder interni e fornitori esterni Lavori simili STORE DESIGN PLANNING BRAND ARCHITECT - 6/9 MESI Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Jaeger-LeCoultre Store Progettazione Interni Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Jaeger-LeCoultre Marketing Activations Project Manager Save Meyrin, Svizzera Jaeger-LeCoultre

jobs.description: Reference code: JR131020 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. ARE YOU A GOOD MATCH? Your management and leadership skills allow you to collaborate, empower and communicate with different teams. Analytical, you are pragmatic and results oriented You are able to drive a portfolio of different projects with strong planning and organization skills You have a strategic and business-oriented mindset. You have a team player attitude and foster collaboration in the team. You have knowledge of SQL, Python and Google Looker. You are fluent in English. WHAT ARE OUR EXPECTATIONS? Within the International Retail Department and reporting to the Retail Performance Senior Manager, you will lead a team of analysts responsible for the creation, diffusion, maintenance, evolution and analysis of various performance indicators and reports for the Retail teams (HQ, regions, markets, boutiques) and the Maison Top Management. In this function, you will: Act as a key ambassador, referent and expert for all retail performance analytical topics for HQ and regional stakeholders. You will identify emerging trends and opportunities. Lead the transition to new Looker reporting tools, encompassing data quality, oversee the design, development and maintenance of dashboards… Track key performance indicators and deliver actionable insights. Lead and manage a team of analysts. Drive a strong performance culture with training programs and build and nurture a cross-functional community. MORE THAN A JOB...We recruit for a career! By joining Van Cleef & Arpels you will be part of a Maison where employee career development is at the heart of our ambition. Upon your arrival, you will be immersed into our enchanting world with trainings on our history, our know-how and our creations. THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS Send your application online. If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Along the recruitment process you will meet the Retail Performance Senior Manager then the Retail Excellence Director. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful. jobs.description: Reference code: JR131014 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. The primary role of the Associate Security Technology Engineer is to support Richemont’s Group Operational Technology/Internet of Things (OT/IoT) security strategy through the deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of OT/IoT security technologies across manufacturing and industrial environments. It operates at the intersection of Group Security, Business Owners, and Maison manufacturing teams, ensuring that OT/IoT security capabilities are aligned with operational constraints, risk profiles, and Group security standards, reinforcing accountability within the First Line of Defense (Group Platform & Group Technology). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Deploy and implement OT/IOT security monitoring technologies across manufacturing and operational environments in line with Group Security standards. Act as an operational Group OT security interface for Manufacturing entities and selected Maisons and Group Platforms & Group Technology Execute the Group OT/IOT security strategy by translating defined requirements into operable and scalable security technology solutions. jobs.title: Central Demand Planning Director
jobs.description: Reference code: JR131187 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Correspondez-vous au profil ? Vous êtes fort(e) d’une expérience significative en tant que directeur(trice) d’une division supply chain. Vous possédez une expérience managériale solide et savez embarquer vos équipes. Vous maitrisez les enjeux business associés à la supply chain et comprenez rapidement les opportunités de votre environnement. Votre expertise vous permet d’apporter une véritable vision long terme sur vos projets. Vos qualités relationnelles vous permettent d’agir en tant que véritable partenaire auprès d’équipes et d’interlocuteurs variés. Vous possédez un fort leadership qui vous permet de convaincre votre interlocuteur afin de lui présenter la meilleure solution. Vous faites preuve d’agilité, de sérénité et de proactivité dans la réalisation de vos missions. Vous maitrisez parfaitement l’anglais Si tel est le cas, n’hésitez pas à postuler ! Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Rattaché(e) au directeur international supply chain, vous êtes le responsable du business planning pour l’ensemble des lignes de produits de la Maison. Vous pilotez et animez, avec votre équipe, l’ensemble des processus prévisions avec les régions et de calculs de besoins, de la gamme et de la nouveauté. Dans le cadre de vos fonctions : Vous êtes responsable des processus clés aval (prévisions de la demande avec les régions, calcul de besoins avec la supply chain amont). Vous coordonnez l’ensemble des différents interlocuteurs projets sur les process transverses (nouveautés, cycles de vie, budget et stock, amélioration continue). Vous animez les processus mensuels : prévisions de ventes, calcul de besoin, stock projeté, écarts prévisions et budgets… Vous animez également les processus annuels et tactiques dont le S&OP. Vous favorisez le Change Management au sein des équipes supply centrale et en région. Vous maintenez le niveau d’excellence de la communauté mondiale (formation dédiée, séminaire, plan d’actions…) Vous managez une équipe de planificateurs centraux. Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière ! Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c’est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition. Vous bénéficierez d’une intégration complète avec des formations sur notre histoire, nos savoir-faire et créations, et un accompagnement au quotidien. Le processus de recrutement Postulez directement en ligne Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l’équipe RH pour un entretien. Vous rencontrez ensuite par étape, le Directeur International Supply Chain puis le Directeur International Opérations & Métiers. Le cas échéant, vous recevez un email vous informant du refus de votre candidature. jobs.title: Laborantin
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131127 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Varinor est une entreprise qui détient la patente d’Essayeur-fondeur et qui approvisionne les marchés horlogers et joaillers en produits semi-finis. MISSION Intégré(e) au sein de l’équipe Laboratoire Matériaux sur le site de Varinor à Delémont, vous réaliserez des analyses (principalement dans le domaine de la préparation d’échantillons, des analyses métallographiques, des essais mécaniques et des analyses physico-chimiques) sur tout type de matériaux dans le but d’améliorer la qualité du produit fini. RESPONSABILITES 
• Vos responsabilités seront les suivantes : Conduire des analyses et divers tests Analyser et interpréter les résultats obtenus et les suivre. Rédiger des rapports d’analyse Poursuivre les analyses selon la nécessité Proposer et mettre en place des actions d’amélioration continue PROFIL Issu(e) d’une formation de laborantin(e) en matériaux/physique ou équivalent, vous justifiez de quelques années d’expérience dans un laboratoire. Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les techniques de préparation pour les analyses métallographiques, la microscopie optique, les essais mécaniques ainsi que les mesures des propriétés physiques et optiques des matériaux. Des connaissances en corrosion des matériaux et/ou sur des techniques d’analyse chimique, telle que ICP-OES, seraient un plus. Vous êtes rigoureux(se), méthodique et faites preuve de facilité d’adaptation et d’apprentissage. Votre esprit d’équipe, votre capacité de réflexion et votre flexibilité seront autant d’atouts pour mener à bien cette mission. jobs.title: Responsable Outillage
jobs.description: Reference code: JR131050 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. CONTEXTE Rattaché au département Support de Production, vous assurez la gestion quotidienne du secteur Outillage afin de garantir l’approvisionnement sans rupture des outils de coupe et consommables, les gains sur achats planifiés et le déploiement de la roadmap de transformation du département. Vos succès contribueront à l’amélioration de la performance de nos ateliers. Force de proposition, vous apportez des solutions innovantes permettant l’amélioration des processus. jobs.title: Head of Group Insurance
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130915 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. About us Richemont is a global leader in the luxury sector, with a prestigious portfolio of Maisons spanning jewellery, watchmaking, and fashion. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and protecting our heritage, while anticipating future challenges. How will you make an impact? We are looking for an experienced and agile Head of Insurance to shape how Richemont manages risk in an increasingly dynamic global environment. As Head of Insurance, you will provide strategic leadership across our Group non-life insurance portfolio, acting as a true business partner to senior leaders to protect our people, assets, and balance sheets, while enabling sustainable growth. This is a distinctive hands-on leadership role where you will define the strategic direction of the function and advise senior leadership, while remaining closely involved in execution. You will be perfectly comfortable presenting to the CFO in the morning and spending the afternoon reviewing wording on a complex policy, coaching a team member through a claim, or preparing a Board paper. You will lead from within the team, actively contributing and supporting, while also empowering your team members to grow with trust and confidence. Your agility will allow you to comfortably navigate and engage with diverse activities and people, from brokers to individual contributors across the Group. Reporting to the Group Treasurer, you will be a trusted advisor to senior leadership and play a key role within the Treasury & Risk Leadership Team. Your Key 
• Responsibilities will be: Strategic Leadership: Shape and execute the Group’s non-life insurance and risk strategy, ensuring it evolves alongside our business priorities and risk profile. You will act as an internal entrepreneur, understanding insurance not just as a cost, but as a critical component of risk financing. Influential Business Partnership: Partner closely with senior leaders across the organization, acting as an ambassador for the insurance function. You will provide commercially pragmatic insurance advice that supports strategic initiatives, operational resilience, and informed decision-making, focusing on influence rather than mere negotiation. Building strong relationships with our Maisons will be paramount. Program Management & Innovation: Lead the design, placement, and governance of Group’s non-life insurance programs, including captive strategy, insurer and broker relationships, and effective claims oversight. You will foster innovation, curiosity, and embrace new approaches, including automation and AI, to continuously improve our processes. Function Optimization: Continuously enhance the effectiveness of the insurance function by leveraging data, technology, and process improvements to optimize the Group's total cost of risk. Strategic Advice Acumen: Provide strategic insight to the Group Treasurer and Treasury Leadership Team on emerging risks, market developments, and opportunities to strengthen the Group's financial resilience. Empowering Team Leadership: Foster a culture of partnership, accountability, and continuous improvement while leading, developing, and inspiring a high-performing global insurance team. You will ensure the team has the space to grow, supported by your trust and confidence. What We Are Looking For: We are looking for a leader whose approach goes beyond technical excellence. You are someone who: Builds trust and lasting relationships across a diverse, global organization, understanding that this role is fundamentally based on strong connections. You are a great business partner and ambassador for the function. Leads with integrity, authenticity, and a strong sense of accountability, setting an example for the team. Balances delegation with active, hands-on involvement, and demonstrate a genuine willingness to support the team in delivering results, while also empowering them to grow. Communicates with clarity and confidence, adapting complex insurance topics for a broad range of stakeholders, from senior executives to individual contributors, and knowing where to influence. Balances strategic thinking with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, demonstrating agility in adapting to new challenges and environments. Is naturally curious, innovative, and collaborative, committed to developing both people and the function, and not afraid to explore new technologies. Possesses a good radar, understanding organizational dynamics and how to navigate them effectively. Your Key Skills & Competencies: Mature, assertive, and self-motivated, demonstrating a positive and proactive attitude. A visionary leader, able to inspire and influence a highly specialized team towards excellence and value-added impact on the organization. Strategic thinking and business acumen with a strong foundation in finance, insurance, and risk management. Results-oriented, acts decisively, and an active team player. Strong customer focus (internal and external) with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to present complex insurance information clearly to non-financial stakeholders, and confident in dealing with different management levels. Skilled at leading cross-functional projects from design to implementation. Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and data analysis skills. Digitally savvy and a strong interest in new technology use, automation. Unquestioned personal integrity with strong ethics and values consistent with company culture. Ability to stand firm on difficult issues when required. Your qualifications: Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Law. Minimum of 15 years of corporate insurance experience, preferably gained through a variety of in-house roles of increasing visibility and responsibility, combined with another experience like broker/consultancy. Expert knowledge of global insurance markets, international insurance programs, and captive experience. A captive board position is a plus. Deep experience in advising the internal organization on insurance matters Ability to think like a businessperson, to integrate insurance and business issues, and to partner with business leaders. Fluent English is a must. What We Offer: At Richemont, we value our employees and offer a stimulating and enriching work environment. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. About us Richemont is a global leader in the luxury sector, with a prestigious portfolio of Maisons spanning jewellery, watchmaking, and fashion. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and protecting our heritage, while anticipating future challenges. How will you make an impact? We are looking for an experienced and agile Head of Insurance to shape how Richemont manages risk in an increasingly dynamic global environment. As Head of Insurance, you will provide strategic leadership across our Group non-life insurance portfolio, acting as a true business partner to senior leaders to protect our people, assets, and balance sheets, while enabling sustainable growth. This is a distinctive hands-on leadership role where you will define the strategic direction of the function and advise senior leadership, while remaining closely involved in execution. You will be perfectly comfortable presenting to the CFO in the morning and spending the afternoon reviewing wording on a complex policy, coaching a team member through a claim, or preparing a Board paper. You will lead from within the team, actively contributing and supporting, while also empowering your team members to grow with trust and confidence. Your agility will allow you to comfortably navigate and engage with diverse activities and people, from brokers to individual contributors across the Group. Reporting to the Group Treasurer, you will be a trusted advisor to senior leadership and play a key role within the Treasury & Risk Leadership Team. Your Key 
• Responsibilities will be: Strategic Leadership: Shape and execute the Group’s non-life insurance and risk strategy, ensuring it evolves alongside our business priorities and risk profile. You will act as an internal entrepreneur, understanding insurance not just as a cost, but as a critical component of risk financing. Influential Business Partnership: Partner closely with senior leaders across the organization, acting as an ambassador for the insurance function. You will provide commercially pragmatic insurance advice that supports strategic initiatives, operational resilience, and informed decision-making, focusing on influence rather than mere negotiation. Building strong relationships with our Maisons will be paramount. Program Management & Innovation: Lead the design, placement, and governance of Group’s non-life insurance programs, including captive strategy, insurer and broker relationships, and effective claims oversight. You will foster innovation, curiosity, and embrace new approaches, including automation and AI, to continuously improve our processes. Function Optimization: Continuously enhance the effectiveness of the insurance function by leveraging data, technology, and process improvements to optimize the Group's total cost of risk. Strategic Advice Acumen: Provide strategic insight to the Group Treasurer and Treasury Leadership Team on emerging risks, market developments, and opportunities to strengthen the Group's financial resilience. Empowering Team Leadership: Foster a culture of partnership, accountability, and continuous improvement while leading, developing, and inspiring a high-performing global insurance team. You will ensure the team has the space to grow, supported by your trust and confidence. What We Are Looking For: We are looking for a leader whose approach goes beyond technical excellence. You are someone who: Builds trust and lasting relationships across a diverse, global organization, understanding that this role is fundamentally based on strong connections. You are a great business partner and ambassador for the function. Leads with integrity, authenticity, and a strong sense of accountability, setting an example for the team. Balances delegation with active, hands-on involvement, and demonstrate a genuine willingness to support the team in delivering results, while also empowering them to grow. Communicates with clarity and confidence, adapting complex insurance topics for a broad range of stakeholders, from senior executives to individual contributors, and knowing where to influence. Balances strategic thinking with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, demonstrating agility in adapting to new challenges and environments. Is naturally curious, innovative, and collaborative, committed to developing both people and the function, and not afraid to explore new technologies. Possesses a good radar, understanding organizational dynamics and how to navigate them effectively. Your Key Skills & Competencies: Mature, assertive, and self-motivated, demonstrating a positive and proactive attitude. A visionary leader, able to inspire and influence a highly specialized team towards excellence and value-added impact on the organization. Strategic thinking and business acumen with a strong foundation in finance, insurance, and risk management. Results-oriented, acts decisively, and an active team player. Strong customer focus (internal and external) with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to present complex insurance information clearly to non-financial stakeholders, and confident in dealing with different management levels. jobs.description: Reference code: JR131328 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. This is a unique opportunity to grow in an exciting and challenging environment, co-building and providing procurement expertise to technology-passionate stakeholders. Richemont is looking for a Technology Procurement Intern to support our Technology Procurement team. Reporting directly to the Head of Technology Procurement and the Technology Category Manager, you will support Group Technology teams in optimizing and executing sourcing strategies for cutting-edge IT categories—including SaaS, cloud services, software, professional services, and hardware—delivering optimal value in terms of quality, service, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Location: Meyrin (Geneva area) Contract Type: 5-month fixed-term contract (Internship) Start Date: ideally January 2027 HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In close partnership with our Group Technology department, Maisons, and regions, you will ensure the successful implementation of our procurement policies and global sourcing strategies. Contribute to Global Category Management: Market Intelligence: Support category intelligence management, including category analysis, spend and risk analysis and best practices identification, to facilitate the implementation of category strategies across the organisation Supplier Relations: Support the management of the preferred suppliers list Value Creation: Propose value creation initiatives, such as rationalization opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Performance: Contribute to enhancing category performance reporting. You are naturally curious, highly structured, and possess strong analytical skills. You are fluent in both English and French (written and spoken). You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (for data and spend analysis) and PowerPoint (for clear presentations). You are in your 4th or, ideally, 5th year of a Master’s degree majoring in Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related business field. You have an active internship agreement (convention de stage) with your school or university. You are available for a 5-month internship ideally starting in September 2026. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? This is a premium opportunity to discover and contribute to both projects and category management within a leading global luxury group. You will join a diverse, dynamic, and highly supportive team working in an international environment where innovation and heritage meet. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US First Contact: If your application is selected, our recruitment team will reach out to you within one week for a brief, informal introductory call. First Interview: A formal interview with our Recruiter to discuss your background and motivations. Final Round: A personal meeting (virtual or in-person) with the Technology Procurement Team to dive deeper into the role and meet your future colleagues. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Piaget Procurement Excellence Intern Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR131328 Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Questa è un'opportunità unica per crescere in un ambiente emozionante e stimolante, la co-costruzione e la fornitura di competenze di approvvigionamento per le parti interessate di tecnologia-passione. Richemont sta cercando una Technology Procurement Internal per supportare il nostro team di approvvigionamento tecnologico. Segnalandosi direttamente al responsabile del approvvigionamento tecnologico e al responsabile della categoria Technology, supporterai i team di Group Technology nell'ottimizzazione e nell'implementazione di strategie di approvvigionamento per le categorie IT all'avanguardia, tra cui SaaS, servizi cloud, software, servizi professionali e hardware, garantendo un valore ottimale in termini di qualità, servizio e costi totali di proprietà (TCO). Ubicazione: Meyrin (area di Geneva) Tipo di contratto: contratto a 5 mesi a tempo determinato (Internship) Data di inizio: idealmente gennaio 2027 COME MAKE AN IMPACT? In stretta collaborazione con il nostro dipartimento di tecnologia di gruppo, Maisons e regioni, vi assicurerete la riuscita attuazione delle nostre politiche di approvvigionamento e strategie di approvvigionamento globale. Contribuire a Global Categoria Management: Intelligenza di mercato: Gestione dell'intelligence di categoria di supporto, compresa l'analisi di categoria, l'analisi di spesa e di rischio e l'identificazione delle best practice, per facilitare l'implementazione delle strategie di categorie in tutta l'organizzazione Sostenere la gestione della lista di rifornimenti preferiti Creazione di valore: iniziative di creazione di valore proposte, tali opportunità di razionalizzazione per migliorare l'efficienza e ridurre i costi. Performance: Contribuire a migliorare la reportistica delle prestazioni della categoria. Sostenere gli storeholders nelle loro attività di approvvigionamento e di approvvigionamento: Advisory: Collaborare con gli stakeholders e consigliarli sulle strategie di approvvigionamento ottimali Esecuzione di processo: contribuisce attivamente alla definizione dei requisiti tecnici/commerciali e all'esecuzione di azioni di approvvigionamento in conformità con le politiche del Gruppo. Supporto completo: Fornire un supporto completo di approvvigionamento per le esigenze legate alla tecnologia: Negoziare le migliori condizioni TCO-wise (pricing, termini e condizioni, SLA, ecc.) Fornire supporto di approvvigionamento in tutti i progetti tecnologici, tra cui la gestione di RFI, RFQ e RFP, così come i rinnovi contrattuali. Assicurarsi il rispetto dei termini negoziati. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Sei un giocatore di squadra proattivo che comunica in modo pulito e porta energia positiva a obiettivi collaborativi. Sei naturalmente curioso, altamente strutturato e possiede forti capacità analitiche. Sei fluente sia in inglese che in francese (scrittore e parlato). Sei competente in Microsoft Excel (per i dati e l'analisi pendente) e PowerPoint (per le presentazioni chiare). Siete nel vostro 4 ° o, idealmente, 5 ° anno di un Master Avete un accordo di stage attivo con la vostra scuola o università. Siete disponibili per uno stage di 5 mesi idealmente a partire dal settembre 2026. Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo? Si tratta di un'opportunità premium per scoprire e contribuire a progetti e gestione delle categorie all'interno di un gruppo di lusso leader a livello globale. Ti unirai a un team diversificato, dinamico e altamente solidale che lavora in un ambiente internazionale dove innovazione e patrimonio si incontrano. IL TUO GIORNO CON US First Contact: Se la vostra domanda è selezionata, il nostro team di reclutamento vi raggiungerà entro una settimana per una breve e informativa chiamata introduttiva. Prima Intervista: Un'intervista formale con il nostro Recruiter per discutere il tuo background e le tue motivazioni. Final Round: Un incontro personale (virtuale o in-persona) con il Team di Appalti tecnologici per vivere più a fondo nel ruolo e incontrare i vostri futuri colleghi. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Simili Jobs Procurement Categoria Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Svizzera Piaget Procurement Excellence Intern Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Svizzera Richemont Procurement Categoria Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Svizzera Richemont

Bezugscode: JR131328 Richemont besitzt einige der Welt Jede Maison Vertreter eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont scheint das Erbe und die Identität jedes seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir der Innovation verpflichtet und entwerfen neue Produkte, die unseren Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, in einem aufregenden und herausfordernden Umfeld zu wachsen, indem man gemeinsam mit anderen technologiebegeisterten Interessengruppen Beschaffungsexpertise zur Verfügung stellt. Richemont sucht nach einem Technologiebeschaffungsinternen, um unser Technologiebeschaffungsteam zu unterstützen. Wenn Sie direkt an den Head of Technology Procurement und den Technology Category Manager berichten, unterstützen Sie die Group Technology-Teams bei der Optimierung und Umsetzung von Sourcing-Strategien für hochmoderne IT-Kategorien - einschließlich SaaS, Cloud-Services, Software, Professional Services und Hardware - und bieten einen optimalen Wert in Bezug auf Qualität, Service und Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Ort: Meyrin (Genf) Vertragsart: 5-monatiger befristeter Vertrag (Praktikum) Startdatum: idealerweise Januar 2027 WIE WIRDEN SIE EINEN WIRKLICHKEITEN? In enger Partnerschaft mit unserer Group Technology Abteilung, Maisons und Regionen stellen Sie die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer Beschaffungspolitik und globalen Beschaffungsstrategien sicher. Beitrag zum globalen Category Management: Market Intelligence: Unterstützen Sie das Category Intelligence Management, einschließlich Kategorienanalyse, Ausgaben- und Risikoanalyse und Best Practices-Identifizierung, um die Umsetzung von Kategorienstrategien in der gesamten Organisation zu erleichtern: Unterstützen Sie die Verwaltung der Vorzugsversorgungsliste Value Creation: Vorgeschlagene Wertschöpfungsinitiativen, wie Rationalisierungsmöglichkeiten, um die Effizienz zu verbessern und Kosten zu senken. Leistung: Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Leistungsberichterstattung in der Kategorie. Unterstützung von Lagerinhabern bei ihren Sourcing- und Supply-Management-Aktivitäten: Beratung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern und Beratung zu optimalen Sourcing-Strategien Process Execution: Aktiver Beitrag zur Definition technischer/geschäftlicher 
• Anforderungen und Durchführung von Beschaffungsmaßnahmen gemäß Konzernrichtlinien. Full Sourcing Support: Bieten Sie umfassende Beschaffungsunterstützung für technologiebezogene Bedürfnisse: Verhandeln Sie die besten Bedingungen TCO-weise (Preise, Bedingungen, SLA usw.) Bereitstellung von Beschaffungsunterstützung bei allen Technologieprojekten, einschließlich der Verwaltung von RFIs, RFQs und RFPs sowie Vertragsverlängerungen. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der ausgehandelten Bedingungen. WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS? Sie sind ein proaktiver Teamplayer, der sauber kommuniziert und positive Energie für kollaborative Ziele bringt. Sie sind natürlich neugierig, hochstrukturiert und besitzen starke analytische Fähigkeiten. Sie sprechen fließend Englisch und Französisch (Schriftsteller und Gesprochen). Sie beherrschen Microsoft Excel (für Daten- und Pend-Analyse) und PowerPoint (für übersichtliche Präsentationen). Sie sind in Ihrem 4. oder idealerweise 5. Jahr eines Masters Sie haben einen aktiven Praktikumsvertrag mit Ihrer Schule oder Universität. Sie stehen für ein 5-monatiges Praktikum zur Verfügung, idealerweise ab September 2026. Was macht unsere Gruppe anders? Dies ist eine erstklassige Gelegenheit, sowohl Projekte als auch Kategorienmanagement innerhalb einer führenden globalen Luxusgruppe zu entdecken und dazu beizutragen. Sie werden einem vielfältigen, dynamischen und sehr unterstützenden Team beitreten, das in einem internationalen Umfeld arbeitet, in dem sich Innovation und Erbe treffen. IHR TAG MIT US-Erstkontakt: Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt ist, wird unser Rekrutierungsteam Sie innerhalb einer Woche für einen kurzen, informativen Einführungsgespräch kontaktieren. Erstes Interview: Ein formelles Interview mit unserem Recruiter, um Ihren Hintergrund und Ihre Motivation zu besprechen. Finalrunde: Ein persönliches Treffen (virtuell oder persönlich) mit dem Technologiebeschaffungsteam, um tiefer in die Rolle einzutauchen und Ihre zukünftigen Kollegen zu treffen. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Piaget Procurement Excellence Intern Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Spécialiste Métier Usinage (Polissage mécanisé)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131376 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. En tant que Spécialiste Métier, vous serez un pilier essentiel de notre atelier de production. 
• Vos responsabilités s'articuleront autour de deux axes majeurs : Apporter une expertise technique pointue sur les procédés de préparation/terminaison sur nos machines CT500/CT501 (en assurant la robustesse des procédés, la reproductibilité des résultats et l’optimisation des performances industrielles) et un soutien opérationnel direct à nos équipes de production. jobs.title: Strategic Projects Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR131449 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. YOUR MISSION: As a valued member of the Strategic Projects team, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to critical initiatives across the Richemont Group. You will actively engage with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders, utilizing your communication and theoretical skills to facilitate collaboration, align objectives, and support partners throughout project lifecycles. This position offers an unparalleled opportunity to develop and apply your project management expertise, encompassing comprehensive reporting, proactive risk management, and meticulous planning, all while learning from experienced professionals. You will be an integral part of a visionary journey, contributing to the strategic evolution of a luxury leader and gaining invaluable experience in navigating complex challenges within a dynamic global environment. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will gain practical experience and make a real difference by focusing on these key responsibilities: Coordination & Project Planning: Take an active role in planning, executing, and monitoring strategic projects across the Group. This includes assisting in defining project scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines. You will gain hands-on experience to ensure efficient project delivery and contribute to the expansion of Richemont's strategic capabilities. Stakeholder Communication & Management: Serve as a key point of contact for project-related communications. You will be responsible for interacting with stakeholders from various departments within the Group, providing regular updates on project status, managing expectations, and facilitating effective collaboration to ensure alignment and foster a shared understanding of project goals. Performance & Financial Reporting: Contribute to the development and delivery of comprehensive project reports, including financial tracking, performance metrics, and progress tracking. Your analytical skills will be crucial in identifying key trends, assessing project health, and providing data-driven insights to support informed decision-making by project leadership. Risk Management & Problem Solving: Assist in identifying potential project risks, developing mitigation strategies, and tracking their resolution. You will apply your problem-solving skills to address challenges that arise during project execution, ensuring minimal disruption and maintaining project momentum. Partner Guidance & Facilitation: Guide external partners involved in projects, ensuring they understand their roles, responsibilities, and project methodologies. You will facilitate workshops and meetings, promoting effective teamwork and ensuring successful execution of project initiatives. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are a Bachelor’s or Master’s student (Business or Engineering School) with a strong desire to enter the field of Project Management. You are open-minded, with effective communication skills (in English and ideally in French as well). You have strong analytical skills, being able to think logically and pay attention to detail. You can easily navigate from a conceptual level of information to a deeper one. You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges. You are comfortable working in a group or independently in a hybrid manner with a focus on efficiency and human interactions. You master Microsoft Office tools like Excel, PowerPoint... You are effective in coordinating projects and have good problem-solving skills. Ideally, you also have a financial skills background. You are available for a 6-month internship as of September 2026. An internship agreement with your school/university is mandatory. You will be offered an opportunity to actively contribute to the establishment of a strategic function within the CIO Office for the Richemont Group and its Maisons. To be part of a dynamic and diverse environment within high-value teams, who possess diverse skills, collaborate effectively, communicate openly, respect one another, and are driven by a shared commitment to achieving goals. The Richemont Group offers you numerous opportunities to ensure healthy and progressive career development in the future. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Clienteling Product Management Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Test Management Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont HR Intern Save Madrid, Spain Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR131471 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for a Senior Manager Data and Analytics to lead a team of data professionals within the Group Responsible and Strategic Procurement department. Reporting to the Procurement Excellence Director, the Senior Manager Data and Analytics will be responsible for defining, implementing, and overseeing the Group Responsible and Strategic Procurement data strategy, analytics capabilities and data governance framework, enabling the Experts within Group Responsible and Strategic Procurement department as well as other stakeholders across the Group such as the Regions and the Maisons, Group Sustainability function, etc. This role drives the transformation of raw data into actionable insights that are key to better understanding or our supply chains, informed business decisions, optimized operations, enhanced customer experiences, and identifying new growth opportunities, fostering a data-driven culture, and ensuring ethical and compliant use of data. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Leadership & Vision: Develop and articulate comprehensive data and analytics vision and strategy aligned with the overall business objectives, fast evolving sustainability regulations context and digital transformation initiatives. Identify, design and prioritize key business questions that can be answered through data analysis, driving value creation. Champion a data-driven culture across the organization, promoting data literacy and the use of analytics for decision-making. Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data science, machine learning, and business intelligence. Act as a strategic advisor to Responsible and Strategic Procurement Leadership, utilizing data-driven insights to identify cost-savings opportunities, mitigate supply chain risks, and drive value creation. Data Management & Governance: Establish and enforce robust data governance policies, standards, and procedures to ensure data quality, integrity, security, privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, Non Financial Report,...). Oversee the architecture, design, and implementation of data platforms and in-house applications, data warehouses, and other data infrastructure. Manage data acquisition, integration, storage, and accessibility across various systems and sources. Ensure data lineage, metadata management, and master data management (MDM) practices are in place. Analytics & Insights Generation: Pioneer and lead the development and deployment of advanced analytics, predictive modelling, and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems. Oversee the creation of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders at all levels. Design and deliver Maisons’ facing reporting frameworks, adapting outputs to varied maturity levels across 20+ Maisons and Regions Collaborate with the department Experts to understand their analytical needs and deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable impact Propose innovative solutions to enhance effectiveness and efficiency of analytics processes. Apply data science methodologies to analyse spend and buying patterns, drive cost savings, mitigate supply and continuity risks, and ensure contract and policy compliance. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Partner closely with Group Data Office teams to operationalise Analytics and AI solutions end-to-end, ensuring they are production-ready, scalable and fully integrated into user experience. Act as a primary liaison between the data and analytics team, Category Managers, Responsible Sourcing leads, Maisons and Regions and department Experts/internal stakeholders Effectively communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. Develop compelling visualisations and data-driven narratives to communicate insights effectively to operational and executive audiences. Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to leverage data capabilities. Team Management & Development: Manage and develop a team of data professionals, fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team environment. Provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the team. Actively upskill the team in advanced analytical methodologies, data storytelling, and the application of next generation AI tools in Procurement. Communicate project status, risks and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. 8+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field, including experience in a management role. Business Acumen: Understanding of business processes and the ability to connect data insights to business objectives. Proven track record of developing and executing data strategies that deliver significant business value. Curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding business challenges. Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical specifications with strong stakeholder management, communication and presentations skills. Proven ability to translate regulatory compliance requirements into data architecture and collection frameworks Technical Skills: Deep understanding of the digital Procurement ecosystem (SAP Ariba,...). Experience with large-scale data platforms and technologies (e.g., cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP; ...). Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and data privacy principles. Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (e.g. SQL, Python, R). Strong, practical understanding of Generative AI (Gen AI) and Agentic AI frameworks, and how they can be applied to optimize procurement processes. Expertise in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau). Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform). Spreadsheet Software: advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, advanced formulas, data modelling). Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and statistical modelling techniques and their application in business. Knowledge of database management systems and ETL processes. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. Exceptional critical thinking abilities to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions. Ability to identify root causes of problems and propose data-driven solutions. Interpersonal Skills: A strategic mindset with a highly collaborative and consultative approach to problem-solving Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely. Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value, collegiality, Courage, Curiosity, Empathy, Humility and Integrity. - We care for the world we live in. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Procurement Process Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont International MCC Data & Analytics Manager Save Paris, France Cartier Procurement Category Manager Save Plan-Les-Ouates, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Référent Chef de Projet Industrialisation
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131555 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? Vous êtes un pilier de l'industrialisation, capable de piloter des projets complexes et de structurer les méthodes ? Rejoignez notre équipe et ayez un impact direct sur nos deux sites de production, en horlogerie comme en joaillerie ! Sous la responsabilité du Responsable des Méthodes, vous serez le point d'entrée stratégique pour l'industrialisation et la conduite de projet. 
• Vos missions principales : Pilotage et Centralisation (50%) : Vous assurez le suivi rigoureux de l'avancement des projets d'industrialisation, garantissant le respect des standards (industrialisation, PLM/ERP) et des plannings. Vous collaborez étroitement avec le Responsable des Méthodes pour optimiser la performance, réduire les coûts, gérer les priorités et définir les standards. Vous centralisez également les sujets techniques liés à la conception en production (CAO/PLM, impression 3D). Industrialisation de Nouveautés (50%) : En tant que Chef de Projet Industrialisation, vous prenez en charge la mise en production de nouveaux produits ou les modifications de l'existant. Vous définissez les gammes de fabrication, les coûts, les matières premières et les outillages. Vous suivez les préséries, élaborez les procédés et réalisez les dossiers d'industrialisation. Support et Expertise : Vous êtes le référent technique des ateliers, apportant votre soutien et travaillant en partenariat avec les équipes de production. Vous assurez également la mise à jour et la maintenance des bases de données techniques. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS RÉUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur et/ou de technicien ET (ou d’un titre équivalent), vous êtes au bénéfice d’une expérience d’au moins 5 années dans un poste similaire. Doté de très bonnes connaissances sur un logiciel de CAO, idéalement CREO, vous avez idéalement eu l’occasion de découvrir le monde de l’habillage horloger ou de la joaillerie à travers votre parcours professionnel ainsi que la gestion de projet. QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ? 
• Nous offrons des horaires flexibles dans un cadre de travail varié et stimulant. Nous bénéficions des avantages de la convention collective de travail des industries horlogères et microtechnique suisse dont 5 semaines de vacances par années auxquelles s’ajoutent des congés additionnels liés au rattrapage. Soucieux de notre impact environnemental, nous privilégions la mobilité douce ainsi que les transports en commun avec une participation financière. Notre restaurant propose chaque jour des repas frais et variés à prix avantageux. Orienté vers le bien-être au travail, notre comité évènement propose de nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives tout au long de l'année. De plus, le groupe Richemont a été certifié Equal-Pay, ce qui assure une rémunération équitable pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs. Sans oublier notre caisse de pension Richemont qui offre de bonnes prestations permettant à chaque collaborateur d’assurer au mieux leur avenir financier lié aux prestations sociales. QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Si votre profil correspond à notre recherche, vous serez, dans un premier temps, contacté par les Ressources humaines pour un appel exploratoire. jobs.title: Data Project Management Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131779 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Company Overview: Our company is a major luxury group consisting of renowned luxury Maisons. As a leader in the luxury industry, we strive to maintain our prestigious reputation and continue driving innovation. The Group Data Office plays a pivotal role in developing the data strategy for the entire group and empowering each Maison to harness the power of data to create value and drive growth. Position Overview: As a key player in Richemont’s data transformation journey led by the Group Data Office, the Data Project Manager Intern will support the enablement of our Maisons, Functions, Divisions and Regions in their capacity to manage and leverage their data securely, autonomously and at scale. Within the Data Enablement team and reporting to our Senior Data Program Manager, the ideal candidate will support in the organization and orchestration of the transformation program for our business entities, focusing on change management, communication, and training coordination. 
• Responsibilities: Assist in Data Transformation Program Management: Help manage the portfolio of initiatives on the data transformation roadmap. Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including Group Technology, Analytics Enablement and Governance Enablement teams to create transformation roadmap, map interdependencies and track progress Collaborate with Maisons and Group Functions to define Data Transformation program objectives and scope. Data Transformation community animation: Support communities of practice or forums to facilitate collaboration on data transformation related initiatives. Build and organize resources, support materials and communication content to support and animate data transformation community Assist other program managers and team members with project management methodologies, tools, and techniques. Data Trainings and Communication support: Orchestrate our training and communication plan working closely alongside Data Office team members and key stakeholders. Work with our internal and external partners to define the communication and training content needs, plan resources accordingly. Review training content provided by contributors to align on messaging, tone and readability for the target audience Assist in Measuring and Communicating Impact: Help track key performance indicators to measure the impact of data enablement initiatives. Assist in providing regular updates on the progress and achievements. Help prepare communication on the success stories and benefits derived from data enablement. 
• Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong interest and knowledge in data, cloud, and related technologies. Experience with enterprise data platforms and/or data visualization tools is a plus. Previous experience in a project management or data related role is a plus. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Detail-oriented mindset with a proactive and problem-solving attitude. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to build trusted relationships within the team and across the organization. Proven creativity and analytical thinking, ability to break down complex tasks. Excellent written communication skills Fluent English is mandatory for this role. French is a plus. Luxury or retail business know-how is a plus. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? We are a very dynamic team, open-minded and extremely curious. jobs.title: Horloger HH
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131708 Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments. En tant que futur(e) Horloger(ère) Haute Horlogerie, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'assemblage et la mise au point de nos montres. Grâce à votre expertise et à votre exigence de qualité, vous contribuerez à garantir la précision, la fiabilité et la performance qui font la réputation de notre Maison. Votre impact Assembler des montres Haute Horlogerie jusqu'au produit fini. Réaliser les réglages et la mise au point des mouvements afin d'en optimiser les performances. Effectuer les contrôles techniques et esthétiques garantissant la conformité de chaque pièce. Assurer les opérations d'emboîtage et d'autocontrôle selon les standards de la Maison. Veiller au respect des exigences qualité tout au long du processus d'assemblage. Identifier les problématiques techniques et contribuer à leur résolution. Participer activement à l'amélioration continue des méthodes et des processus de l'atelier. Contribuer à l'atteinte des objectifs de performance, de qualité et de fiabilité du département. 
• Votre profil Être titulaire d'un CFC d'horloger(ère), d'horloger(ère) rhabilleur(se) ou d'une formation équivalente. Maîtriser les techniques de réglage et de mise au point horlogère. Posséder de bonnes connaissances des mouvements Haute Horlogerie. Faire preuve d'une grande minutie, de rigueur et d'un sens aigu de la qualité. Travailler de manière autonome tout en cultivant un fort esprit d'équipe. Démontrer des capacités d'analyse et une volonté constante de progresser et d'améliorer l'existant. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Panerai, vous évoluerez au sein d’un environnement dynamique et international, guidé par une passion commune pour l’innovation et la précision. Nous valorisons la diversité des profils, des perspectives et des expériences, en mettant les forces de chacun au service de la réussite collective. 
• Nous offrons des opportunités d’apprentissage continu et de développement, afin de permettre à chacun de construire une carrière épanouissante au sein de Panerai. ​ Votre parcours avec nous Après la sélection de votre candidature, notre équipe des Ressources Humaines vous contactera pour un premier échange. Au cours du processus, vous échangerez avec le responsable du poste, des partenaires clés et des membres de notre équipe de direction. Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you. jobs.description: Reference code: JR131616 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. BACKGROUND This key role is part of a strategic project aimed at harmonizing accounting and financial practices within our F&A Maisons. Join this unique opportunity to: Actively contribute to the optimization of our processes and implementation of common standards Directly impact the efficiency and transparency of manufacturing finance. Contribute to a strategic and transformative project. Develop your skills in project management and process harmonization. Gain enriching and invaluable experience for your professional career, by collaborating with several F&A Maisons. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Based in Bellevue and reporting to the Head of F&A Manufacturing controlling, your missions will include, but are not limited to: Participation in Gap analysis: Collaborate with F&A teams of Maisons to analyze manufacturing entities' financials, harmonize practices, ensure compliance with Group accounting policies, and support decision-making. Support project definition and implementation phase: Validate and communicate accounting changes, assist F&A Maisons in adopting harmonized standards, including budget and forecasting. Support F&A finance team to elevate industrial finance expertise: Help entities to adopt the Group framework, establish an industrial setup, define and monitor KPIs, conduct benchmarking, and challenge performance. Change management support: Contribute to documenting new practices, user training (where relevant), support the implementation of new processes, and facilitate best practice sharing, liaising with IT as appropriate. Coordination and communication: Facilitate communication and collaboration between stakeholders (F&A teams of Maisons, IT, etc.), monitor project progress, and report to management as appropriate. This role involves punctual travel in Europe. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Deep understanding of Manufacturing cost elements and related accounting principles. Strong knowledge of P&L cost structure based on standards costs and variance analysis. Strong project management skills and methodologic approach. Data Analytics and reporting competencies. Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools. Highly developed analytical and synthesis skills. Flexibility and curiosity, with the ability to work autonomously and learn quickly. Dynamic team player, with excellent communication skills and ability to interact with diverse stakeholders, and challenge the status quo. Proactivity and initiative to propose improvement opportunities. Education, experience and core competencies University degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Control or similar. Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in controlling, audit, project finance, or a similar role, ideally in an industrial or manufacturing environment. Experience in the F&A sector is a plus. Certification in project management is an asset Knowledge of SAP and Anaplan is a plus. Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken) is essential. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. jobs.description: Reference code: JR131611 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. As Master Data Administrator, you will be responsible for the operational stewardship and daily maintenance of financially relevant master data, ensuring its consistency, completeness and timely updates across multiple systems. You will execute master data processes in line with business priorities, internal guidelines and master data best practices, supporting the efficient execution of finance and business processes. Playing a crucial role in the day-to-day management of critical foundational master data, you will ensure alignment with defined rules and controls, perform verification activities, support users and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and business projects. How will you make an impact? As part of Group Finance and based in Bellevue, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas: Master Data Stewardship and Controls Maintain financial master data (e.g. boutiques, investment projects, profit centers, chart of accounts and key translation tables) in SAP SEM and SAP ERP Coordinate processes and maintain legal entity master data for consistency across financial, corporate, contract, and treasury systems. Manage the Group article hierarchy in ERP, aligning Brand requirements with Group Finance guidelines. Maintain hierarchy, coordinate changes, and validate financially relevant article master data. For all master data domains, execute controls for integrity, security, and compliance, as well as operate/maintain processes and tools, and create documentation. Master Data Quality Management Conduct regular data audits and reconciliation to ensure master data consistency, accuracy, and compliance across systems. Support implementation and maintenance of data quality processes and tools with stakeholders. Apply and support data governance policies for master data objects, focusing on cross-system data quality standards. Continuous Improvement and Business Support Identify and support implementation of master data process and tool enhancements. Provide operational input for master data system enhancements and new functionalities. Act as an operational reference in business projects for master data, contributing to system implementations and improvements. Serve as a point of contact for master data queries, guiding users and troubleshooting issues. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Ability to work across different levels of the organization and various functional teams, facilitating communication between end users and regional counterparts. Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy when working with complex data sets. Practical problem-solving for operational data issues and user support Strong communication and interpersonal skills to support users, clarify requests and coordinate operational master data activities. Strong organizational and time management skills. Education, experience and core competencies Master of Science in Finance or similar field with data science and economics background 3 years’ experience in finance data analysis, with exposure to multiple systems, within a multinational Luxury company Strong expertise in financial modelling, using BI tools (PBI, SAC, Looker, etc.) Proficiency in SAP FI/CO modules Expert in Excel Proficient in basic data checks, reporting extracts and operational follow-up tools, including PBI, Google Looker or similar. Familiar with data governance policies and procedures, with the ability to apply defined rules in daily activities. Familiar with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI prompting and basic automation concepts. Proficiency in French and English is required WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value, collegiality, Courage, Curiosity, Empathy, Humility and Integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Field Services Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group Technology Junior Financial Controller Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Watches & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont
