jobs.description: Reference code: JR131796 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. BACKGROUND This role is part of a strategic project aimed at harmonizing accounting and financial practices within our W&J Maisons. Join this unique opportunity to: Actively contribute to the optimization of our processes and implementation of common standards Directly impact the efficiency and transparency of manufacturing finance. Contribute to a strategic and transformative project. Develop your skills in project management and process harmonization. Gain enriching and invaluable experience for your professional career, by collaborating with several W&J Maisons. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Based in Bellevue and reporting to the Head of W&J Manufacturing controlling, your missions will include, but are not limited to: Drive Operational Excellence & Industrial Performance Lead monthly financial closing and reporting for the W&J industrial perimeter, providing analysis of operational highlights, cost structures, and manufacturing variances. Contribute to the consolidation and analytical review of financial data for budgets and reforecasts, ensuring alignment with Group guidelines. Proactively identify and implement process optimizations, streamlining workflows to enhance efficiency and automate manual tasks. Conduct ad-hoc financial and cost analyses to support strategic decision-making and team objectives. Ensure data reliability, quality, and automation within our data model, supporting digital transformation initiatives to optimize reporting tools. Contribute to Strategic Projects Participate in key projects focused on standardizing and harmonizing industrial costing definitions across all W&J production entities. Lead data collection and modeling to establish robust comparative benchmarks for Group manufacturing sites, focusing on operational efficiency, productivity, and cost competitiveness. Develop high-quality analytical slides and dashboards, fostering clear communication and alignment with diverse stakeholders across the Group and Maisons. This role involves punctual travel in Europe. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Strong familiarity with project management methodologies and data collection processes. Highly developed analytical and synthesis skills. Flexibility and curiosity, with the ability to work autonomously and learn quickly. Dynamic team player, with excellent communication skills and ability to interact with diverse stakeholders, and challenge the status quo. Proactivity and initiative to propose improvement opportunities. Highly self-motivated, with ability to manage multiple deadlines Education, experience and core competencies University degree in Finance, Controlling, Accounting or similar. Minimum 5 years of solid experience in manufacturing/industrial controlling, audit, financial planning & analysis), or project finance. Strong understanding of manufacturing cost elements, standard costing, variance analysis, and industrial P&L structures. Expert level in Excel Strong knowledge of P&L cost structure based on standards costs and variance analysis. Experience in the W&J, Luxury, or high-end manufacturing sector is a plus. Hands-on experience with SAP (FI/CO) and consolidation tools as well as Power Query, Power Pivot, or Looker is highly valued Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken) is essential. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Manufacturing Controller Save Valenza, Italy Buccellati Group Technology Junior Financial Controller Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Purchasing Excellence Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR131944 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Correspondez-vous au profil ? Vous maîtrisez la gestion de projet et démontrez une réelle capacité à accompagner et mener le changement au sein d'une organisation. Vous avez une excellente compréhension des enjeux business et une connaissance approfondie des outils, systèmes achats, procédures de compliance et pratiques d’achats durables. Doté(e) d'une forte appétence pour le digital, vous êtes à l'aise avec la manipulation de données, l'analyse et la construction de tableaux de bord (Excel, PowerPoint, PowerBI, SAP). Vos qualités relationnelles et de communication vous permettent d'agir en véritable partenaire, de collaborer efficacement et d'engager activement des interlocuteurs variés. Vous faites preuve d’initiative, de responsabilité, d'autonomie et d'un engagement fort dans la réalisation de vos missions. Vous maîtrisez parfaitement l’anglais. Si tel est le cas, n’hésitez pas à postuler ! Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Rattaché(e) au Directeur Achats Indirects de la Maison, vous êtes le garant de l’excellence opérationnelle et de la compliance des process liés aux Achats Indirects. Vous accompagnez la Maison dans la digitalisation et l'harmonisation de ses pratiques via une approche end-to-end, en étroite synergie avec le Groupe et les autres Maisons. Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes : Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous implémentez les standards achats et qualité, optimisez les processus et menez les projets d'amélioration continue pour l'équipe sur l'ensemble des catégories d'Achats Indirects. Compliance & Gestion des Risques : Vous veillez à l’application de la Politique Achats de la Maison, pilotez les audits et assurez le suivi des plans d’actions associés. Transformation & Digitalisation : Vous travaillez à la digitalisation des processus achats/qualité et accompagnez le changement pour délivrer le maximum de valeur. Transmission : Vous développez et déployez des toolkits et des programmes de formation alignés avec les standards du Groupe pour accompagner la montée en compétences des équipes. Analyse & Reporting : Vous maintenez à jour les données achats, concevez et communiquez les tableaux de pilotage d’activité et assurez le reporting régulier des KPIs de l'équipe (du S2P au P2P). Animation de communauté : Vous contribuez activement à l'animation de la communauté Procurement Excellence au niveau de la Maison et du Groupe. Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière ! Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c’est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition. Vous bénéficierez d’une intégration complète avec des formations sur notre histoire, nos savoir-faire et créations, et un accompagnement au quotidien. Le processus de recrutement Postulez directement en ligne. Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l’équipe RH pour un entretien. Vous rencontrez ensuite par étape, le Directeur Achats Indirects de la Maison, puis les interlocuteurs clés de la Direction des Opérations. Le cas échéant, vous recevez un email vous informant du refus de votre candidature. jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132136 Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments. As our next Boutique Manager, you will embark on a pivotal mission to shape the success of our prestigious Geneva boutique. You will develop and optimize the boutique performance and profitability through operational excellence and a refined clienteling strategy, maximizing sales and ensuring every interaction reflects our Maison's standards. As a true ambassador, you will lead, coach, and inspire your team in line with our Maison’s values, fostering talent development for individual career growth and collective team success. Your impact Drive and exceed global commercial, qualitative, and operational performance objectives through strategic planning, rigorous analysis, and adherence to Maison and Group standards. Develop and execute market strategies, including in-boutique events and external networking, to enhance commercial opportunities and adapt to local economic environments. Cultivate strong client loyalty and relationships, particularly with VVIPs, by leveraging CRM tools and fostering a data-driven culture for optimal customer insights. Ensure impeccable retail execution and operational discipline, utilizing performance metrics like Mystery Shopping/NPS for continuous improvement and close collaboration with Headquarters. Lead, recruit, and develop an agile, high-performing team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, coaching, and strong team spirit to achieve excellence. Act as a brand ambassador, upholding the Maison's image, values, and rituals, and ensuring impeccable boutique presentation and representation within the local ecosystem. Oversee secure and accurate inventory management, maintain visual merchandising standards, and champion the adoption of new retail tools and digital solutions. 
• Your profile Minimum of 10 years' experience in luxury goods retail, preferably in luxury watches, with significant managerial experience in sales and customer service. Demonstrated strong leadership capabilities, including the ability to build trust, motivate teams, delegate effectively, and foster a collaborative, team-oriented environment. Exceptional client-centric approach, with a deep understanding of luxury client expectations, local clientele in Geneva, and proven experience in clienteling and executing community engagement initiatives. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective cross-functional collaboration, project implementation, and successful change management. Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset, exhibiting initiative, innovation, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and business growth. Reliable, independent, and sales-driven, with a poised, composed, and social demeanour, ready to take initiative. Fluency in English and French is required, with Italian considered a highly advantageous skill. Why join us We are a dynamic Maison where the culture is deeply rooted in Collaboration, Shared Accountability and Excellence in Execution. You will partner in an international environment that brings together diverse talents, perspectives, and experiences to drive collective success. 
• We offer the opportunity to continuously learn, grow, and build a fulfilling career within Panerai. Your recruitment journey After your application has been selected, our Talent Acquisition team will reach you to conduct an introductory call. Along the process you will have conversations with the hiring manager, key business partners, and members of our executive team. Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you. jobs.title: Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132092 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. MAIN PURPOSE The Group Sustainability team has progressed with the consolidation and integration of its Non-Financial Reporting Framework, specifically building on the Swiss Non-Financial Reporting requirements. Looking ahead, the fast-moving Non-Financial Reporting landscape, driven by a growing number of regulatory requirements, entails the ongoing enhancement of non-financial reporting processes. In this context, the Sustainability Transformation team's primary objectives are to oversee the Non-Financial Reporting Framework, and support the continuous improvement of the Group Sustainability Framework. KEY RESPONSIBILITES The Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern will assume a key role in the following areas: Provide assistance in the continuous improvement of the Richemont Non-Financial Reporting Framework, ensuring alignment with the GRI and other relevant Standards; Support the ESRS gap assessment and the formalisation of improvement plans; Support the critical review of GRI disclosures and the ongoing update of required documentation (e.g. GRI Index; Basis of Preparation); Support the critical review of regulatory requirements (e.g. CSRD), including benchmark analysis; Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely reporting; Support the team in collecting, analysing non-financial information (e.g. content collection template update), conducting data quality check to ensure accuracy and completeness of non-financial reporting; Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting processes and tools, including digital solutions. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132169 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. BACKGROUND Embark on a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the financial landscape of our Group Platforms department. In this transversal role, you will drive essential financial activities, primarily focusing on cost controlling, financial planning, and internal allocation model management. To succeed in this role, you should have a demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. 
• Your responsibilities will be dynamically split, with 70% dedicated to hands-on controlling tasks, working closely with managers to ensure financial rigor, and 30% focused on providing essential support to the wider controlling team, particularly in enhancing data quality and streamlining administrative functions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As part of Group Finance and based in Meyrin, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas: Drive Financial Performance & Control Oversee day-to-day financial operations for our technology domains and cost centers, ensuring efficient and appropriate financial control systems. Actively contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, including preparing accruals, reviewing commitments, and assisting with allocation cycles. Partner closely with Group Technology Managers to foster cost awareness and enhance understanding of financial performance, providing insightful analysis and ad-hoc reports. Support the tracking and monitoring of resources for key technology projects and initiatives. Master Planning & Forecasting Play a key role in the planning and forecasting cycles (Budget, Latest Estimate, Roadmap), from data collection and analysis to presentation and report preparation. Assist in the review and consolidation of budget components (Investments, Operating expenses, Headcounts) for supported areas. Prepare preliminary management reports and conduct initial variance analysis against financial targets. Ensure Financial Integrity & Compliance Support the Capital Approval Request (CAR) process and contribute to the follow-up of financial commitments, including budget assumption validation and vendor contract checks. Assist in the control and validation of Purchase Orders (PO) in close collaboration with the P2P team. Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of cost allocation models, ensuring accurate evaluation of internal and business services. Support the application of Richemont's internal controlling procedures, identifying and addressing potential gaps. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Conduct regular and thorough checks on financial data quality within systems, particularly for time allocation entries and master data accuracy. Identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data integrity issues. Assist in collecting, validating, and consolidating financial data from various sources for reporting and analysis. Contribute to identifying and implementing process improvements within the controlling function, focusing on automation and efficiency. Provide support for ad-hoc financial analysis, data extraction, and special projects as required. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Strong team spirit and communication skills with aptitude to collaborate transversally across various teams, organizations, and stakeholders. Curious to learn, develop, and contribute to challenging the status-quo. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an ability to pay close attention to detail. Good organizational abilities with proactivity, and keen to work independently while managing ambiguity with guidance when necessary. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, and balance multiple priorities. Education, experience and core competencies University graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 1 to 3 years’ experience in a finance or controlling role, preferably within a multinational environment. Relevant internships will be considered. Familiarity with SAP FICO, Anaplan and/or BI tools is an asset. Knowledge of coding languages (like Python), AI prompts (Copilot), and/or RPA. Strong proficiency in Excel is required Demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. Fluent in English, French knowledge is a strong asset. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value curiosity, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, excellence, courage, collaboration, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Technology Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Watches & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR132169 Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. BACKGROUND Embarcarsi su un'opportunità unica per contribuire attivamente al paesaggio finanziario del nostro dipartimento Piattaforme di Gruppo. In questo ruolo trasversale, guiderai attività finanziarie essenziali, concentrando principalmente il controllo dei costi, la pianificazione finanziaria e la gestione del modello di allocazione interna. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si dovrebbe avere un interesse dimostrato per gli argomenti tecnologici, in particolare nelle aree di servizi digitali, infrastrutture e dati.
• Le tue responsabilità saranno divisi dinamicamente, con il 70% dedicato ai compiti di controllo pratico, lavorando vicino ai manager per garantire rigore finanziario, e il 30% incentrato sul fornire supporto essenziale al team di controllo della larghezza, in particolare nel migliorare la qualità dei dati e le funzioni amministrative di streaming. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Come parte del Gruppo Finanza e con sede a Meyrin, le vostre responsabilità comprenderanno, ma non sono limitate a, i seguenti settori chiave: Drive Financial Performance & Control Overseas operazioni finanziarie giornaliere per la nostra tecnologia home e centri di costo, garantendo sistemi di controllo finanziario efficienti e adeguati. Contribuisce attivamente alle attività di chiusura finanziaria mensili, trimestrali e annuali, tra cui la preparazione di incrementali, la revisione di impegni e l'assistenza con cicli di allocazione. Collabora con Group Technology Manager per promuovere la consapevolezza dei costi e migliorare la comprensione delle prestazioni finanziarie, fornendo analisi approfondite e report ad-hoc. Sostenere il monitoraggio e il monitoraggio delle risorse per i progetti e le iniziative di tecnologia chiave. Master Planning & Forecasting Gioca un ruolo chiave nei cicli di pianificazione e previsione (Budget, ultima stima, Roadmap), dalla raccolta e analisi dei dati alla preparazione di presentazione e report. Assistere nella revisione e consolidamento dei componenti di bilancio per le aree sostenute. La preparazione dei rapporti preliminari di gestione e l'analisi di variazione iniziale contro gli obiettivi finanziari. Garantire l'integrità finanziaria e la conformità Supporta il processo Capital Approval Request (CAR) e il contributo al follow-up di impegni finanziari, tra cui la validazione dell'assunzione di bilancio e i controlli contrattuali del venditore. Assistere nel controllo e nella convalida degli ordini di acquisto (PO) in stretta collaborazione con il team P2P. Contribuisce alla manutenzione e al miglioramento dei modelli di allocazione dei costi, garantendo una maggiore valutazione dei servizi interni e aziendali. Sostenere l'applicazione delle procedure interne di controllo di Richemont, identificare e affrontare potenziali lacune. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Condurre controlli regolari e approfonditi sulla qualità dei dati finanziari all'interno dei sistemi, specificamente per le voci di allocazione del tempo e la precisione dei dati master. Identificare le discrepanze, indagare le cause delle radici e collaborare con gli stakeholder per risolvere i problemi di integrità dei dati. Assistere nella raccolta, validazione e consolidamento dei dati finanziari da varie fonti per la segnalazione e l'analisi. Contribuire a identificare e implementare i miglioramenti dei processi all'interno della funzione di controllo, concentrandosi sull'automazione e sull'efficienza. Fornire supporto per l'analisi finanziaria ad-hoc, l'estrazione dei dati e progetti speciali come richiesto. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Competenze trasversali Forte spirito di squadra e capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di collaborare tra diverse squadre, organizzazioni e stakeholder. Curioso imparare, sviluppare e contribuire a vincere lo status quo. Forte capacità analitiche e quantitative, con la capacità di prestare molta attenzione ai dettagli. Buone capacità organizzative con produttività, e continuare a lavorare indipendentemente mentre gestiscono l'ambiguità con la guida quando necessario. Capacità di lavorare in modo efficace in un ambiente frenetico sotto linee strette, e bilanciare più priorità. Istruzione, esperienza e core concorsi Università laureato in Finanza, Contabilità, Business Administration, Ingegneria, o un campo correlato. Da 1 a 3 anni I rapporti internazionali saranno considerati. La familiarità con gli strumenti SAP FICO, Anaplan e/o BI è una risorsa. Conoscenza delle lingue di codifica (come Python), AI precoce (Copilota), e/o RPA. Una forte professionalità in Excel è necessaria Dimostrata interesse per gli argomenti tecnologici, in particolare nelle aree di servizi digitali, infrastrutturali e dati. Fluente in inglese, la conoscenza francese è un bene forte. Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra speciale capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Apprezziamo la curiosità, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. Promuoviamo empatia, eccellenza, coraggio, collaborazione e integrità. Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. Il nostro giorno con noi La vostra domanda sarà attentamente esaminata dai nostri team di reclutamento, che vi darà un follow-up a breve. Se il tuo profilo viene selezionato, ti contatteremo per un'intervista telefonica iniziale. Il prossimo passo sarà un'intervista con i Manager e il nostro HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Technology Procurement Internal Save Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont Orologi & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 mesi) Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 mesi) Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont

Bezugscode: JR132169 Richemont besitzt einige der Welt Jede Maison Vertreter eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont scheint das Erbe und die Identität jedes seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir der Innovation verpflichtet und entwerfen neue Produkte, die unseren Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. Begeben Sie sich auf eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, aktiv zur Finanzlandschaft unserer Abteilung für Gruppenplattformen beizutragen. In dieser transversalen Rolle treiben Sie wesentliche Finanzaktivitäten voran, die sich hauptsächlich auf Kostenkontrolle, Finanzplanung und internes Allokationsmodellmanagement konzentrieren. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie ein Interesse an Technologiethemen haben, insbesondere in den Bereichen Digital, Infrastruktur und Datendienste.
• Ihre Aufgaben werden dynamisch aufgeteilt, wobei 70% für praktische Controlling-Aufgaben, die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Managern zur Gewährleistung finanzieller Strenge und 30% für die Bereitstellung wesentlicher Unterstützung für das Breitencontrolling-Team, insbesondere für die Verbesserung der Datenqualität und das Streaming von Verwaltungsfunktionen, vorgesehen sind. WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND? Als Teil von Group Finance mit Sitz in Meyrin umfassen Ihre Aufgaben, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf die folgenden Schlüsselbereiche: Drive Financial Performance & Control Overseas Tagesgeschäfte für unsere Technologie-Haus und Kostenstellen, um effiziente und angemessene Finanzkontrollsysteme zu gewährleisten. Aktiver Beitrag zu monatlichen, vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Finanzabschlussaktivitäten, einschließlich der Vorbereitung von Erhöhungen, der Überprüfung von Mittelbindungen und der Unterstützung bei Zuweisungszyklen. Zusammenarbeit mit Group Technology Managern, um das Kostenbewusstsein zu fördern und das Verständnis der finanziellen Leistung zu verbessern, indem aufschlussreiche Analysen und Ad-hoc-Berichte bereitgestellt werden. Unterstützung der Nachverfolgung und Überwachung von Ressourcen für wichtige Technologieprojekte und -initiativen. Master Planning & Forecasting Spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in den Planungs- und Prognosezyklen (Budget, Latest Estimate, Roadmap), von der Datenerfassung und -analyse bis hin zur Präsentation und Erstellung von Berichten. Unterstützung bei der Überprüfung und Konsolidierung von Haushaltskomponenten für unterstützte Bereiche. Erstellung vorläufiger Managementberichte und Durchführung einer ersten Varianzanalyse im Vergleich zu den Finanzzielen. Sicherstellung der finanziellen Integrität und Compliance Unterstützung des Capital Approval Request (CAR)-Prozesses und Beitrag zur Nachverfolgung von Finanzzusagen, einschließlich der Validierung von Budgetübernahmen und Verkäufervertragsprüfungen. Unterstützung bei der Kontrolle und Validierung von Bestellungen (PO) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem P2P-Team. Trägt zur Pflege und Verbesserung von Kostenverteilungsmodellen bei und sorgt für eine verstärkte Bewertung interner und geschäftlicher Dienstleistungen. Unterstützung der Anwendung der internen Kontrollverfahren von Richemont, um potenzielle Lücken zu identifizieren und zu schließen. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Führen Sie regelmäßige und gründliche Überprüfungen der Finanzdatenqualität innerhalb von Systemen durch, insbesondere für Zeitvergabeeinträge und Stammdatengenauigkeit. Identifizieren Sie Diskrepanzen, untersuchen Sie die Ursachen und arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um Datenintegritätsprobleme zu lösen. Unterstützung bei der Sammlung, Validierung und Konsolidierung von Finanzdaten aus verschiedenen Quellen für die Berichterstattung und Analyse. Beitrag zur Identifizierung und Implementierung von Prozessverbesserungen innerhalb der Controlling-Funktion mit Fokus auf Automatisierung und Effizienz. Unterstützung für Ad-hoc-Finanzanalysen, Datenextraktion und spezielle Projekte nach Bedarf. WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS? Transversale Fähigkeiten Starker Teamgeist und Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit der Fähigkeit, in verschiedenen Teams, Organisationen und Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten. Neugierig zu lernen, zu entwickeln und dazu beizutragen, den Status quo zu gewinnen. Starke analytische und quantitative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, auf Details zu achten. Gute organisatorische Kapazitäten mit Produktivität, und bleiben Sie unabhängig arbeiten, während Sie bei Bedarf Mehrdeutigkeiten mit Anleitung verwalten. Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung unter engen Linien effektiv zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten auszugleichen. Ausbildung, Erfahrung und Kernwettbewerbe Hochschulabsolvent in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich. 1 bis 3 Jahre Reporting Internationalships werden berücksichtigt. Die Vertrautheit mit SAP FICO, Anaplan und/oder BI-Tools ist eine Bereicherung. Kenntnisse der Programmiersprachen (wie Python), der frühen KI (Copilot) und / oder RPA. Starke Professionalität in Excel ist erforderlich Nachgewiesenes Interesse an Technologiethemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Digital, Infrastruktur und Datendienste. Fließend in Englisch, Französisch Wissen ist ein starkes Kapital. Was macht unsere Gruppe anders? Unsere wahre Kraft liegt nicht in unseren Ähnlichkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer besonderen Fähigkeit, ungenutzte Potenziale zu fördern. Wir schätzen Neugier, Kollegialität, Loyalität und Solidarität. Wir fördern Empathie, Exzellenz, Mut, Zusammenarbeit und Integrität. Wir kümmern uns um die Welt, in der wir leben. UNSER TAG MIT UNS Ihre Bewerbung wird von unseren Rekrutierungsteams sorgfältig geprüft, die Ihnen in Kürze ein Follow-up geben werden. Wenn ihr profil ausgewählt ist, werden wir sie für ein erstes telefoninterview kontaktieren. jobs.title: Test Management Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132208 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT As a Test Manager intern, you will become a key member of our Quality Assurance team, contributing to the harmonisation of testing practices and the exploration and implementation of AI-driven testing solutions across our domain. You will work closely with an existing Test Manager, embedded in a Product team, reporting to a senior member of the QA leadership. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? (Mention 3 quantitative responsibilities) By bringing valuable insights and a quality-focused mindset, you will contribute to the evolution of our testing landscape. Support the harmonisation of testing methodologies: Assist in documenting, standardizing, and promoting best practices for testing within & across various product teams, aiming for improved efficiency and consistency in our ways of working. Contribute to AI for testing initiatives: Participate in the research, exploration, and initial implementation phases of AI-powered testing tools and strategies, helping to identify potential use cases and measure their impact on testing efficiency and coverage. Collaborate with Test Managers embedded in Product Areas: Work alongside embedded Test Managers to understand their specific testing challenges, gather requirements for harmonisation efforts, and support the integration of new testing approaches and tools. Assist in the preparation of test strategies, test plans, and test reports. Help organize and facilitate workshops or training sessions related to new testing tools or methodologies. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? (What skills do they need to succeed) You are doing a master's degree or are recently graduated (Business or Engineering School) with a strong interest in software quality assurance, testing methodologies, and emerging technologies like AI. You can follow a rapid learning curve and show impactful results (be a doer) after a short discovery phase. You can understand transversal topics from IT to Business requirements, with an ability to grasp the big picture of quality assurance within a large organization. You have a quality-orientated mindset, with an eye for detail and can propose improvements in our testing processes and deliverables. You are effective in communication and can work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and other test managers. You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges in a dynamic environment. Eager to master Test Management and Quality Assurance within an IT environment Skilled in Microsoft 360 (Teams, PowerPoint, Excel & Word), know-how of Atlassian Suite is a bonus. Strong proficiency in English and French is a must. You are available for a 6-month internship with a start date in April 2026 You are eligible for an internship agreement. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? (Work environment and culture) At Richemont, we believe in fostering an environment where every team member can thrive and feel valued. As an Intern Test Manager, you will: Be part of a dynamic and supportive team: Enjoy the various personalities of our team, participate in regular team events, and engage in a variety of activities that promote collaboration and camaraderie. Benefit from mentorship and learning: Work closely with experienced professionals who are dedicated to your growth, providing guidance and opportunities to expand your skills in quality assurance and AI for testing. Contribute to meaningful projects: Your work will directly impact the quality and efficiency of our different scope of activities, giving you a sense of purpose and achievement. Enjoy a stimulating and innovative atmosphere: Be at the forefront of exploring new technologies like AI in testing, contributing to the future of quality assurance within a leading luxury group. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first technical interview with Nathalie Cappelletti; and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs QA Development Lead Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Quality Engineer — Omnichannel Order Execution Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Salesforce Developer Lead Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132340 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. As part of its strategic development in Switzerland, Buccellati is looking for a Boutique Manager capable to handle the opening and success of the boutique. Your mission: As an Ambassador of the Buccellati Maison, you will be responsible of the development and optimization of the boutique performance and profitability by managing the boutique team, ensuring excellence in boutique operations and in delivering the best client service and experience. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. You will be in charge of the daily operations of the boutique (front and back office) with the aim to communicate the overall brand message in a successful manner to generate business. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining and promoting the Buccellati brand image and identity, following the Company’s directives. You will be accountable for ensuring maximum sales and profitability of the boutique through merchandise, inventory, expense control and human resources management. Your Key 
• Responsibilities: Boutique performance & Sales achievement: Achieve or surpass monthly and yearly sales targets of the boutique; Meet or exceed the KPI’s set by Retail Management; Respect the brand’s discount policy; Establish budget, track sales and expenses. Maintain budget and related costs within established guidelines; Develop and implement the boutique action plan with the commercial department with a focus on business development; Ensure the sales growth; Gain market share; Review competition trends, recommend and initiate changes for maximizing goals and objectives; Management: Set, implement and supervise the Boutique sales strategy; Guarantee the implementation and regular monitoring of the Boutique action plan (Result driven, monthly review and keep update, monitor and follow up the plan); Ensure compliance with all policies and procedures through regular store management and staff meetings, store walk-through, audits .. ; Together with the Visual Merchandising Team, ensure that the standards on store image are kept according to Company guidelines and coordinate the proper training for sales staff; Ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels; Ensure proper attire, grooming and behavior in line with the brand’s guidelines; Grant the compliance to operational procedures provided by the Group; Lead by example & Team spirit: lead and motivate the team to accomplish and maximize the sales target and retail KPIs; Oversee the boutique maintenance; Handle all customer’s enquiries and complaints; Customer Relations Management: Treat the customer according to brand’s standards: ensure that each customer receives outstanding standards, solid product knowledge and all other components of Customer Service; Act as a Brand Ambassador when representing the Brand at meetings, events (local & international) and other work-related functions; Build strong customer relationships and enhance loyalty; Acquire a relevant customer database, convert into sales transaction and retain the customer for future transactions; Monitor & execute the Boutique CRM program; Team Management: Performs all necessary supervisory functions to effectively and efficiently manage the personnel assigned: Hire, lead and act as advisor to boutique team regarding projects, tasks and operations; Define and communicate missions and objectives of all team members, clearly establishing priorities and reasonable deadlines; Formulate sales team’s goals and objectives, motivate staff and reinforce engagement; Motivate the boutique team around the strategy and vision of the Maison; Fosters a cooperative and harmonious working climate to maximize employees morale and productivity; Act as a coach and assist the colleagues in operations, sales and training; Job profile: Bachelor graduated with at least 10 years retail experience, preferably in luxury jewelry/watchmaking sector; Qualification/ training in watches & jewelry, knowledge of diamond grading and design; Preferably with qualification in gemology; Ability to work in a fast-paced retail store environment; MS Office experience required (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Fluency in English and French is mandatory; the knowledge of another language is a plus (Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Italian); Personal Skills: Managerial skills and proactive approach; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are required; Ability to delegate tasks and follow up to ensure execution; People friendly and comfortable dealing with VIP clients; Excellent representation skills; Focused, target oriented and organized; Strong understanding of Customer Service needs and Customer (internal and external) priorities; Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision; Self-Starter with Team-Player approach; Similar Jobs Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Stock Administrator Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati

Contribuirai a sviluppare una profonda comprensione e conoscenza della Maison per trasmettere il suo DNA di marca, l'artigianato riconosciuto e l'innovazione in tutte le sue creazioni. Assicurarsi di attrarre, curare e comportarsi in linea con le linee guida dei marchi; Concedere la conformità alle procedure operative previste dal Gruppo; Guidare per esempio & Team spirit: guidare e motivare il team per raggiungere e massimizzare il target di vendita e i KPI retail; Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Team Performance Training Department we are looking for an INTERN TEAM PERFORMANCE TRAINING (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: November 2026 In this stimulating internship, you are working on HQ Team Performance Training projects while being in close contact with our international platforms, giving a global dimension to this position. The role is allocated within the Global Commercial Team and reports directly to the Global Head of Team Performance and Digital Training. YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Ad-hoc analysis of global commercial KPIs. Preparation and analysis of sales data for market coaching, market visits and executive management presentations. Creation and further development of existing coaching and training tools, content, roadmaps, tracking, feedback coordination, etc. Support with creation of digital training content via our internal app and presentation content related to product, service and performance. Support virtual studio operation and creation of studio presentations. Organization and coordination of large HQ-trainings (approx. 2-3 trainings per internship). Support for the Team Performance Training Team with additional needs in administration, budgeting, reporting, new project management etc. HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. 
• Your profile should combine both quantitative (e.g., analytical thinking, number crunching, etc.) and qualitative (e.g., creative ideas, design affinity, etc.) skills: Currently enrolled or recently graduated from a bachelor's or master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality or similar. First experience in the field of Sales / Retail / Marketing / Finance / Consulting is a plus. Team player with strong analytical and project management skills. Independent, dedicated and highly motivated individual with a high affinity for our brand and strong enthusiasm for our products. Proactive and flexible mindset with a hands-on mentality. Very strong digital tool knowledge and at ease with different software solutions, especially Excel and PowerPoint (SAP knowledge is an asset). Fluent in English (excellent written and verbal communication) is a must and any other language is a plus. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. IWC offers you a challenging working environment: rooted in Switzerland, but operating successfully internationally. We combine tradition with innovation and attach great importance to change management, training and further education as well as personal development. Find below a selection of fringe benefits provided by us: Daily food & beverage allowance of CHF 7, redeem-able in the in-house restaurant and selected restaurants in Schaffhausen. Yearly health insurance contribution of CHF 2'340 for full-time contracts. 25 days vacation annually (30 days as of the age of 50), 5 additional bridge compensation days. Special conditions on selected IWC & Richemont products. Diverse health & wellbeing initiatives and programs, including financial support for external childcare. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) for sport enthusiasts. Attractive workplace adjacent to the river rhine, inviting for social activities amongst colleagues. Memorable internal events (Christmas, summer after work drinks, etc.). And many more! jobs.title: Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132495 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT Supply Chain is a key driver of Maisons’ overall performance. It must be agile to provide the best end-to-end product availability and ensure client satisfaction, anytime and anywhere. Group Supply Chain Solutions act as an internal consulting branch, supporting Maisons in their transformation ambitions. Our mission: foster Supply Chain transformation to strengthen Maisons’ competitive advantage. You will discover in Richemont a strong manufacturing ecosystem and work closely with the Maisons and the internal manufactures HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will promote analytics & reporting tools Create, improve and maintain the upstream analytics and reporting tools Support Maison’s to leverage the analytics and reporting tools implemented Contribute to ongoing projects Support the preparation and animation of workshops Run ad-hoc analysis to support ongoing projects and bring data-base insights to the team Formalize outputs of analysis/workshop to prepare steering comittees You will support the Upstream growth and structuring Co-design and build methodological kit of our best practices Build user guide for our in-house tools Create communication support to promote initiatives internally WHAT ARE THE EXCEPTIONAL SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR? Enrolled in the last year of a Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering Industrial Supply Chain experience/knowledge Good organization and communication skills Appetence for data-analytics combined with solid analytical skills Solid dashboard/visualization tool skills (PowerBI) SQL basics are a plus Fluent in English and French HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains. You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two thousand years of heritage with cutting edge innovation. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Geneva, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132531 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. We are looking for enthusiastic, passionate, dynamic people to join our new retail team in Geneva! Main purpose: The Boutique Sales Associate is a fully engaged individual who is committed to contributing to the success of the opening of the new Buccellati boutique in Geneva, with the ambition to grow with the Maison. If you are looking for an opportunity to enter the world of High Jewellery, craftmanship and you are curious to learn more, this role has a lot to offer. Your mission will be to promote the Buccellati brand image as per the Company’s directives. Your mission: You will become a Brand Ambassador of Buccellati Maison in the Boutique as well as at external events, and you will be responsible for delivering a unique client experience by sharing memorable inspiring moments. You will foster trusted relationships with clients all along the journey with the Maison. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. You will be part of a team, transmitting and sharing knowledge with the other team members, actively participating in the day-to-day boutique life. Your 
• Responsibilities: Sales performance & customer service: Contribute to the boutique achieving its sales targets; Assist clients with Customer Service needs maintaining the brands high standards; Cultivate strong client relationships, delivering outstanding client service and treatment; providing a friendly environment which includes greeting and acknowledging every customer, maintaining outstanding standards and solid product knowledge; Adapt approach according to the client needs and motivations; Assist and support after sales clients in accordance with Maison values; provide recommendations that will provide an exceptional client experience; 2. Stock management and merchandising: Provide feedback in processing and replenishing merchandise; participate in receiving and monitoring floor stock; Actively participate in the visual merchandising of the Boutique implementing required guidelines. Assist in floor moves, merchandising, display maintenance, and store housekeeping, including cleaning the products and displays; Assist in the inventory process, including but not limited to stock counting and special projects as needed; Assist in completing prices changes within the Boutique when required; 3. Boutique operations and cash management: Accurately and efficiently complete all sales transactions and maintain proper cash records at the Boutique’s register; Adhere to all Company policies, procedures and practices; Implement discounts and gratuities under supervision of Boutique manager; Comply with all safety regulations and Boutique operational procedures including security; 4. Product knowledge & sales techniques: Maintain an awareness of all product knowledge information; Master the Brand's sales techniques as per training received; Attendance to required training; 5. Presentation & visibility: Maintain boutique tidiness, decoration and visual merchandising in line with Brand guidelines; Report maintenance issues to the Boutique Manager; Represent the Brand by wearing the appropriate provided uniform; Represent the Brand instore and at local events under the direction of Boutique Manager; Your 
• Profile: 2 to 5 years of previous experience in luxury retail, ideally in the Jewellery universe; Ability to work in a fast-paced retail store environment MS Office experience required; Fluency in French and English is mandatory, Italian is an advantage; Strong knowledge of local clientele; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are required; Confidence in handling high-value transactions; Strong understanding of Customer Service needs and Customer (internal and external) priorities; Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision; Self-Starter with Team-Player approach; Must be available to work retail hours including in the evenings, during weekends and to travel for trainings, client events, conferences; Similar Jobs Boutique Manager Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Sales Associate Save Tivoli, Italy Buccellati

Codice di riferimento: JR132531 Buccellati è una rinomata Maison italiana di alto livello fondata nel 1919, ammirata per l'artigianato e l'unicità delle sue creazioni. Oggi, i gioielli Bucellati si distinguono per il loro design e per le tecniche utilizzate per crearli, come la tecnica d'incisione a mano, risalente alle antiche tradizioni orafatiche del Bucellati italiano fa parte del Global Luxury Group Richemont dal settembre 2019, ma la famiglia Bucellati è ancora presente nella Società con funzioni manageriali di alto livello. Le boutique Bucellati sono presenti nelle città più importanti e nei centri commerciali più prestigiosi del mondo. Siamo alla ricerca di persone entusiaste, passionali, dinamiche per unire il nostro nuovo team di vendita al dettaglio a Ginevra! Obiettivo principale: The Boutique Sales Associate è un individuo pienamente impegnato che si impegna a contribuire al successo dell'apertura della nuova boutique Bucellati a Ginevra, con l'ambizione di crescere con la Maison. Se siete alla ricerca di un'opportunità per entrare nel mondo dell'Alta Gioielleria, dell'artigianato e siete curiosi di saperne di più, questo ruolo ha molto da offrire. La vostra missione sarà quella di promuovere l'immagine del marchio Buccellati secondo la Compagnia La vostra missione: Diventerai un Brand Ambassador di Bucellati Home in Boutique e in eventi esterni, e sarai responsabile di offrire un'esperienza clienti unica condividendo momenti di ispirazione della memoria. Incoraggiate relazioni di fiducia con i clienti per tutto il viaggio con la Maison. Contribuirai a sviluppare una profonda comprensione e conoscenza della Maison per trasmettere il suo DNA di marca, l'artigianato riconosciuto e l'innovazione in tutte le sue creazioni. Sarete parte di un team, trasmettendo e condividendo le conoscenze con gli altri membri del team, partecipando attivamente alla vita boutique quotidiana. Il tuo
• Responsabilità: prestazioni di vendita e servizio clienti: Contribuisce alla boutique soddisfare i suoi obiettivi di vendita; Assistere i clienti con il Servizio Clienti ha bisogno di mantenere gli standard elevati dei marchi; Crescere forti relazioni con i clienti, fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale e il trattamento; fornire un ambiente amichevole che include il verde e l'identificazione di ogni cliente, mantenendo standard e solide conoscenze del prodotto; approccio Adapt secondo le esigenze e le motivazioni del cliente; Assistere e supportare i clienti dopo le vendite in accordo con i valori della Maison; fornire raccomandazioni che forniranno un'esperienza cliente eccezionale; 2. Gestione e merchandising delle scorte: fornire feedback nella lavorazione e la restituzione della merce; partecipare a ricevere e monitorare lo stock del pavimento; partecipare attivamente alla merchandising visiva della Boutique implementando le linee guida richieste. Assistere nelle mosse del pavimento, merchandising, manutenzione del display, e immagazzinare la pulizia di prodotti e display; Assistere nel processo di inventario, compreso ma non limitato alla pianificazione delle scorte e progetti speciali come necessario; 3. Operazioni di Boutique e gestione del denaro: Completare con precisione ed efficacia tutte le transazioni di vendita e mantenere i propri registri di cassa presso la Boutique Adhere a tutte le politiche, procedure e pratiche aziendali; Sconti di implementazione e mance sotto la supervisione di Boutique Manager; Complimenti di tutte le normative di sicurezza e procedure operative di Boutique tra cui sicurezza; 4. Conoscenze di prodotto e tecniche di vendita: Mantenere una consapevolezza di tutte le informazioni sulla conoscenza del prodotto; Master le tecniche di vendita del Brand come per formazione ricevuta; Attendere di richiedere la formazione; 5. Presentazione & visibilità: Mantenere la tidiness boutique, decorazione e visual meandrchising in linea con le linee guida di Brand; Segnala problemi di manutenzione al Boutique Manager; Rappresenta il marchio sentendo l'uniforme fornita appropriata; Rappresentare il Brand instore e in eventi locali sotto la direzione di Boutique Manager; Il Tuo
• Profilo: da 2 a 5 anni di esperienza precedente nella vendita al dettaglio di lusso, idealmente nell'universo della gioielleria; Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio veloce esperienza MS Office richiesto; Fluency in francese e inglese è mandato, italiano è un vantaggio; Conoscenza forte della clientela locale; Sono necessarie eccellenti competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione; Confidenza nella gestione di transazioni ad alto valore; Forte comprensione delle esigenze del servizio clienti e delle priorità del cliente; forte attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di gestire più compiti contemporaneamente e con precisione; Auto-Starter con approccio Team-Player; deve essere disponibile per lavorare ore di vendita al dettaglio anche negli eventi, nei fine settimana e per viaggiare per allenamenti, eventi clienti, conferenze; Simili Jobs Shop Manager Save Geneva, Svizzera Bucellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Svizzera Bucellati Sales Associate Save Tivoli, Italia Bucellati

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132493 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we believe in the power of dreams and the artistry of emotion. We are seeking a dedicated and elegant individual to join our Maison in Zurich as a Sales Associate. If you are passionate about exceptional service and the enchanting world of High Jewellery, we invite you to discover this unique opportunity. Do you match this profile? You are adaptable, an empathetic communicator, and an attentive listener, embodying the grace and care synonymous with our Maison. You possess a deep passion for the enchanting world of High Jewellery, the unique universe of Van Cleef & Arpels, and the exquisite artistry of craftsmanship. You are naturally at ease in a refined boutique environment, engaging with a diverse clientele during their boutique visits and high-profile events, both international and local, with discernment and warmth. You are seeking a collaborative and benevolent team environment where a shared passion for exceptional client care contributes to a truly harmonious atmosphere. You hold a university degree and speak fluent Swiss German, German, and English, and proficiency in a fourth language will be a strong advantage. You possess proven experience within luxury jewellery or watches Maisons, demonstrating an innate understanding of sophisticated service and elegance. A genuine appreciation for the world of high jewellery, luxury goods, and the unique savoir-faire that defines Van Cleef & Arpels. Interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to articulate the Maison's heritage and creations with elegance and conviction, allowing you to create a long lasting relationship with the clients. A natural ability to anticipate and exceed the expectations of a sophisticated clientele, delivering an unparalleled client experience. Proficient in using IT tools such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint and email. If so, we would love to get to know you! What do we expect from you? As a Sales Associate in our boutique, you are the voice of Van Cleef & Arpels for our clients, and you build and maintain strong relationships with them. You are an ambassador of the Maison, promoting its image both internally and externally. You demonstrate excellent commercial acumen and actively participate in the recruitment and development of new clients. You aim to offer a unique experience to our loyal clients. You convey the refinement, elegance, and innovation that inspire the Maison's creations. You leverage your passion for history and art, complemented by a breadth of general knowledge, to cultivate exceptional bonds with our most discerning clientele More than a job... an experience! Joining Van Cleef & Arpels means becoming part of a revered Maison where the growth and flourishing of our talents are paramount. You will embark on a comprehensive onboarding journey, offering a rich tapestry of training on our illustrious history, unparalleled savoir-faire, and iconic creations, complemented by continuous daily support within a benevolent and collaborative environment. We believe in recognizing exceptional talent and dedication. 
• We offer a competitive remuneration package that reflects the value we place on our team members and their contributions to the Maison's enduring legacy. Joining Van Cleef & Arpels also means becoming part of Richemont, a global leader in luxury, offering a world of opportunities to grow within prestigious Maisons, each renowned for its unique artistry and heritage. Apply online. If your profile is selected: You will be contacted by the Talent Acquisition team for an initial online interview. A boutique-based interview will follow to meet the management team. You will then meet the Retail Manager and HR Business Partner for the Swiss market. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132535 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. We are looking for enthusiastic, passionate, dynamic people to join our new retail team in Geneva! Your 
• Responsibilities Inventory Management Responsible for stock replenishment and novelties Track stock levels, place purchase orders (POs), and coordinate with the store team and head office for stock replenishment and transfers Receive, inspect, and verify merchandise against orders, ensuring accuracy and quality standards. Report any discrepancies or damaged products to the Boutique Managers. Oversee stock levels, coordinate deliveries, and monitor inventory accuracy. Classify, tag, and organize stock in accordance with store procedures for easy accessibility and replenishment. Conduct and assist with monthly inventory counts, reconciling discrepancies and ensuring records are up-to-date. Manage the handover and follow-up of maintenance goods, ensuring proper documentation and tracking. Support daily system operations related to stock management as per policy Financial Operations Reconcile daily sales documents, invoices, and cashier operations, ensuring compliance with company standards. Maintain accurate records, handle correspondence, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures. Manage tax receipts and statements, including monthly tax control system operations. Oversee processes related to returns and replacements, ensuring accurate records and compliance. Store Operations Support Assist with budget tracking, expense management, and preparation of financial reports. Manage daily operations, including scheduling, maintenance, and vendor coordination. Prepare sales, inventory, and operational reports for management review. Work closely with the Boutique Manager and staff to ensure operational needs are met. Ensure that health and safety standards, as well as company guidelines, are followed Monitor and manage inventory of store supplies (e.g., visual merchandising materials, stationery, packaging, guest refreshments). Ensure timely ordering and replenishment. Assist with VM display adjustments, monthly display reports, and inventory of props. Maintain store operation manuals and ensure adherence to company processes and standards. Provide occasional support during sales activities. Ensure high housekeeping standards and vigilance regarding security measures in the store. Your 
• Profile 2-3 years of experience in retail in a similar position. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook). Strong organizational and time-management skills with a keen eye for detail. Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work collaboratively in a team environment. Fluent in English and French, Italian is an advantage. jobs.description: Reference code: JR132527 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Social Media & Content Team we are looking for an INTERN SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: November 2026 Join our team and become a key player in shaping our social media and content marketing campaigns. Reporting to the Team Lead, Social Media & Content, you will manage social media channels, develop engaging content, and collaborate with external and internal teams on innovative projects. This role also offers the opportunity to acquire an overview of the entire global brand marketing campaign scope, from orchestration to implementation. We are looking for someone with a passion for luxury, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach. If you are a detail-oriented team player with a keen eye for copy and design, we encourage you to apply! YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Social Media Write and design Instagram stories, providing art direction for these visual formats in collaboration with our inhouse creative team Prepare content briefs and coordinate the design process with the creative team Responsible for planning and scheduling daily social media posts across diverse platforms, optimizing the content calendar, and paid investment support in collaboration with the Social Media and Content Manager Coordinate social media assets for retailers Content Manage relationships with agencies and copywriters Develop new content projects and identify opportunities to leverage existing content in innovative ways Assist with the coordination of special IWC shoots and provide administrative support for photo and video shoots Collaborate with the Events, FOBs, PR, and Creative Center departments on content creation and project development Responsible for developing and collaborating with the Team Lead, Social Media & Content, on our major partnerships and racing topics Marketing campaigns Support the coordination and implementation of the social media campaigns Track campaign status, timelines, and implementation progress Assist in campaign orchestration Contribute to the development of post-campaign reports and performance summaries HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. Currently enrolled in or recently completed bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Marketing, and/or Communications Passionate about social media and content in an international luxury company Passionate about luxury and you have an aesthetic sensitivity Good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint are required Business fluent English skills are required Resilient, dynamic, and team player personality with a pro-active and curious attitude Curiosity towards consumer trends and needs, especially in the luxury environment Able to work in a fast-paced environment with clear, prompt, and concise reporting style graphic and design knowledge Detail-oriented and task-driven WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. IWC offers you a challenging working environment: rooted in Switzerland, but operating successfully internationally. We combine tradition with innovation and attach great importance to change management, training and further education as well as personal development. Find below a selection of fringe benefits provided by us: Daily food & beverage allowance of CHF 7, redeem-able in the in-house restaurant and selected restaurants in Schaffhausen. Yearly health insurance contribution of CHF 2'340 for full-time contracts. 25 days vacation annually (30 days as of the age of 50), 5 additional bridge compensation days. Special conditions on selected IWC & Richemont products. Diverse health & wellbeing initiatives and programs. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) for sport enthusiasts. Attractive workplace adjacent to the river rhine, inviting for social activities amongst colleagues. Memorable internal events (Christmas, summer after work drinks, etc.). And many more! descriptionByLocale.de: Bezugscode: JR132527 Wir sind Macher. Denker. Strategen. Geschichtenerzähler. Seit über 150 Jahren sind wir von Tradition geprägt, vom Fortschritt angetrieben und von Menschen angetrieben. jobs.title: Logistic Digital & Data Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132522 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? This internship will provide you with hands-on experience in logistics performance management, master data and digital transformation. You will be fully integrated in Richemont Internal Distribution Logistic Agility team to contribute to different projects and initiatives. Your key responsibilities will include: DATA & ANALYTICS Logistics Reporting Support: Assist in setting up and improving logistics dashboards, ensuring alignment with global KPIs and reporting guidelines. Continuous Improvement: Participate in logistics optimization projects and develop new methodologies to enhance performance measurement. Data Management Support: Use BI tools (Power BI, SAP, GCP, Looker) to analyze and visualize logistics performance data. DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION Process Analysis & Optimization: Map existing processes to identify inefficiencies, manual bottlenecks, and key opportunities for digitalization and automation. Solution Design & Implementation: Support the design, development, and deployment of logistic digital tools. Project Support: Contribute to ongoing digital transformation initiatives, supporting the implementation as well as helping with documentation. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are currently pursuing a Master’s/Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong interest in logistics, performance management, and data analysis or digital transformation, Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SAP, SQL and capable of structuring and managing databases. Proactive and autonomous, with a self-driven mindset and a can-do attitude. Detail-oriented and rigorous, able to synthesize and communicate complex analyses effectively. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data/processes and provide actionable recommendations. Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills, to collaborate with various internal stakeholders. Fluent in French and English. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? At Richemont, we embrace a culture of performance and continuous improvement. We foster diversity, collaboration, and innovation, providing an engaging and dynamic environment to tackle tomorrow’s logistics challenges. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will contact you for an initial discussion. You will then have the opportunity to meet the team and gain insights into the role’s challenges and expectations. Ready to take on the challenge? Apply now! #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Logistics Digital Transformation Manager Save Tokyo, Japan Richemont Supply Chain Knowledge Management Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Sustainability Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont
